CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3) 计算。\n//!\n//! 多项式 0xEDB88320（反射形式），初始值 0xFFFF_FFFF，结果取反。\n//! 与 zlib/PNG 的 CRC-32 相同。纯标准库实现，不依赖 crc32 crate。\n\n/// 预计算 256 项查表（懒构造一次）。\nfn table() -> &'static [u32; 256] {\n    use std::sync::OnceLock;\n    static TABLE: OnceLock<[u32; 256]> = OnceLock::new();\n    TABLE.get_or_init(|| {\n        let mut t = [0u32; 256];\n        let mut i = 0usize;\n        while i < 256 {\n            let mut c = i as u32;\n            let mut k = 0;\n            while k < 8 {\n                c = if c & 1 != 0 { 0xEDB88320 ^ (c >> 1) } else { c >> 1 };\n                k += 1;\n            }\n            t[i] = c;\n            i += 1;\n        }\n        t\n    })\n}\n\n/// 计算 `data` 的 CRC-32。\npub fn crc32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {\n    update(0xFFFF_FFFF, data) ^ 0xFFFF_FFFF\n}\n\n/// 以给定的中间 CRC 状态继续计算（调用方负责初始/取反约定）。\npub fn update(mut crc: u32, data: &[u8]) -> u32 {\n    let t = table();\n    for &b in data {\n        crc = t[((crc ^ b as u32) & 0xFF) as usize] ^ (crc >> 8);\n    }\n    crc\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    /// 标准向量：CRC-32(\"123456789\") == 0xCBF43926\n    #[test]\n    fn known_vector() {\n        assert_eq!(crc32(b\"123456789\"), 0xCBF43926);\n        assert_eq!(crc32(b\"\"), 0);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn differs_by_one_bit() {\n        let a = crc32(b\"hello\");\n        let mut v = b\"hello\".to_vec();\n        v[0] ^= 0x01;\n        assert_ne!(a, crc32(&v));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_0092d3533e017d73ff5345a8","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2948,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":26424,"output_tokens":721,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"e1969a44-9d59-41a0-b001-4b1b81a3f4fc","timestamp":"2026-09-22T15:51:12.059Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

{"parentUuid":"bf17054c-e655-4676-a0d4-c4677dc0abf4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_5wrl8chk7erpcott5uxrwkqb","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b/src/frame.rs","content":"//! 记录帧的磁盘封装格式。\n//!\n//! # 帧布局（小端序，共 20 + N 字节）\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! 偏移  长度  字段        说明\n//! 0     4     magic       固定 b\"SLG1\"，段起始/帧起始哨兵\n//! 4     8     seq         u64 单调递增记录序号（从 0 开始，逐条 +1）\n//! 12    4     payload_len u32 负载字节数 N\n//! 16    4     crc         CRC-32(seq_le || payload_len_le || payload)\n//! 20    N     payload     原始负载字节\n//! ```\n//!\n//! 注意：magic 不参与 CRC，它是独立的帧哨兵；crc 覆盖 seq、长度与负载。\n//! 损坏任意字段都会被检出：\n//! - magic 翻位/长度域损坏导致读到非 `SLG1` 或长度越界 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - seq/负载翻位 -> CRC 不匹配 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - 文件在一帧写完前结束（短读）-> [`FrameError::Truncated`]，\n//!   恢复时仅允许这一种情况出现在最后一个段的尾部并被丢弃。\n\nuse crate::crc::crc32;\nuse std::io;\n\n/// 帧头长度：4 magic + 8 seq + 4 len + 4 crc。\npub const HEADER_LEN: usize = 20;\n/// 帧头魔数。\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b\"SLG1\";\n/// 单条负载的硬上限（16 MiB）。既是合理性检查，也防止损坏长度域触发巨量分配。\npub const MAX_PAYLOAD: u32 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// 单帧解析结果。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Frame {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 帧解析错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum FrameError {\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧已完整（或长度声称完整）但内容不合法：\n    /// magic 错误、长度越界、CRC 不匹配等。恢复时视为中间损坏，必须报错。\n    Corrupt { at: u64, reason: &'static str },\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧在文件结束处被写了一半（短读）。\n    /// `present` 为实际读到的字节数。仅允许出现在最后一段尾部。\n    Truncated { at: u64, present: usize },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for FrameError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason } => {\n                write!(f, \"corrupt frame at offset {at}: {reason}\")\n            }\n            FrameError::Truncated { at, present } => {\n                write!(f, \"truncated frame tail at offset {at} ({present} trailing bytes)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for FrameError {}\n\n/// 将一条记录编码为一个完整帧，追加到 `out`。\npub fn encode(seq: u64, payload: &[u8], out: &mut Vec<u8>) {\n    debug_assert!(payload.len() <= MAX_PAYLOAD as usize);\n    let len = payload.len() as u32;\n    let mut crc_buf = Vec::with_capacity(12 + payload.len());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    let crc = crc32(&crc_buf);\n\n    out.extend_from_slice(MAGIC);\n    out.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(payload);\n}\n\n/// 编码单帧的便捷函数。\npub fn encode_vec(seq: u64, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(HEADER_LEN + payload.len());\n    encode(seq, payload, &mut out);\n    out\n}\n\n/// 从 `buf` 的起始位置解析一帧。\n///\n/// `at` 是该帧在段文件内的偏移（仅用于错误定位）。\npub fn decode_at(buf: &[u8], at: u64) -> Result<Frame, FrameError> {\n    // 短读：连帧头都不完整。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN {\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n    if &buf[0..4] != MAGIC {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"bad magic\" });\n    }\n    let seq = u64::from_le_bytes(buf[4..12].try_into().unwrap());\n    let len = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[12..16].try_into().unwrap());\n    let crc_stored = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[16..20].try_into().unwrap());\n\n    if len > MAX_PAYLOAD {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"payload length exceeds limit\" });\n    }\n    // 长度域指向帧边界之外：\n    // - 若声称的帧跨越文件实际结尾，属于长度域损坏（完整帧不可能这样）；\n    //   调用方需保证 buf 恰好是“本帧起、到文件尾”的剩余字节。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN + len as usize {\n        // 边界细分：文件尾只缺一部分。若长度域本身可疑（例如剩余字节连一个\n        // 合理帧都凑不齐），仍按损坏处理，因为短读只可能发生在“真实写入中断”，\n        // 而真实中断时长度域是完好的、文件在帧中部结束。\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n\n    let payload = &buf[20..20 + len as usize];\n    let mut crc_buf = Vec::with_capacity(12 + len as usize);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&buf[4..12]);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&buf[12..16]);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    if crc32(&crc_buf) != crc_stored {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"crc mismatch\" });\n    }\n\n    Ok(Frame { seq, payload: payload.to_vec() })\n}\n\n/// I/O 读取辅助：保证读满 `buf`，遇 EOF 返回 false（部分填充）。\npub fn read_exact_or_eof<R: io::Read>(r: &mut R, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<bool> {\n    let mut filled = 0;\n    while filled < buf.len() {\n        match r.read(&mut buf[filled..]) {\n            Ok(0) => return Ok(filled == 0 && false || false).map(|_| false).or_else(|_| {\n                if filled == 0 {\n                    Ok(false)\n                } else {\n                    // 不应到达：read 返回 0 且部分填充时统一在调用处按短读处理；\n                    // 这里把已填充长度留在 buf 中并通过特殊错误传回。\n                    Err(io::Error::new(\n                        io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                        PartialFill(filled),\n                    ))\n                }\n            }),\n            Ok(n) => filled += n,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}\n            Err(e) => return Err(e),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(true)\n}\n\n/// 内部：短读时携带已读字节数的 I/O 错误载荷。\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct PartialFill(usize);\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn round_trip() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(7, b\"abc\");\n        assert_eq!(raw.len(), HEADER_LEN + 3);\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 7);\n        assert_eq!(f.payload, b\"abc\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_payload() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(0, b\"\");\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 0);\n        assert!(f.payload.is_empty());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn header_short_read_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        for cut in 0..HEADER_LEN {\n            match decode_at(&raw[..cut], 0) {\n                Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, cut),\n                other => panic!(\"cut {cut}: expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn body_short_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        // 帧头完整但负载被切。\n        match decode_at(&raw[..HEADER_LEN + 2], 0) {\n            Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, HEADER_LEN + 2),\n            other => panic!(\"expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn payload_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        let last = raw.len() - 1;\n        raw[last] ^= 0x80; // 翻最后一个负载字节\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn seq_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[4] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn magic_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[0] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn len_field_flip_detected() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        // 把长度从 4 翻成一个大数：声称跨越边界。\n        raw[12] = 0xFF;\n        let res = decode_at(&raw, 0);\n        assert!(matches!(\n            res,\n            Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. }) | Err(FrameError::Truncated { .. })\n        ));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_7f741390642bfc7a5403076c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1668,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":28472,"output_tokens":2783,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"7d346aca-7fa9-4717-98d4-3bd5c93b28c2","timestamp":"2026-09-22T15:52:15.357Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

记录帧的磁盘封装格式。\n//!\n//! # 帧布局（小端序，共 20 + N 字节）\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! 偏移  长度  字段        说明\n//! 0     4     magic       固定 b\"SLG1\"，段起始/帧起始哨兵\n//! 4     8     seq         u64 单调递增记录序号（从 0 开始，逐条 +1）\n//! 12    4     payload_len u32 负载字节数 N\n//! 16    4     crc         CRC-32(seq_le || payload_len_le || payload)\n//! 20    N     payload     原始负载字节\n//! ```\n//!\n//! 注意：magic 不参与 CRC，它是独立的帧哨兵；crc 覆盖 seq、长度与负载。\n//! 损坏任意字段都会被检出：\n//! - magic 翻位/长度域损坏导致读到非 `SLG1` 或长度越界 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - seq/负载翻位 -> CRC 不匹配 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - 文件在一帧写完前结束（短读）-> [`FrameError::Truncated`]，\n//!   恢复时仅允许这一种情况出现在最后一个段的尾部并被丢弃。\n\nuse crate::crc::crc32;\nuse std::io;\n\n/// 帧头长度：4 magic + 8 seq + 4 len + 4 crc。\npub const HEADER_LEN: usize = 20;\n/// 帧头魔数。\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b\"SLG1\";\n/// 单条负载的硬上限（16 MiB）。既是合理性检查，也防止损坏长度域触发巨量分配。\npub const MAX_PAYLOAD: u32 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// 单帧解析结果。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Frame {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 帧解析错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum FrameError {\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧已完整（或长度声称完整）但内容不合法：\n    /// magic 错误、长度越界、CRC 不匹配等。恢复时视为中间损坏，必须报错。\n    Corrupt { at: u64, reason: &'static str },\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧在文件结束处被写了一半（短读）。\n    /// `present` 为实际读到的字节数。仅允许出现在最后一段尾部。\n    Truncated { at: u64, present: usize },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for FrameError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason } => {\n                write!(f, \"corrupt frame at offset {at}: {reason}\")\n            }\n            FrameError::Truncated { at, present } => {\n                write!(f, \"truncated frame tail at offset {at} ({present} trailing bytes)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for FrameError {}\n\n/// 将一条记录编码为一个完整帧，追加到 `out`。\npub fn encode(seq: u64, payload: &[u8], out: &mut Vec<u8>) {\n    debug_assert!(payload.len() <= MAX_PAYLOAD as usize);\n    let len = payload.len() as u32;\n    let mut crc_buf = Vec::with_capacity(12 + payload.len());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    let crc = crc32(&crc_buf);\n\n    out.extend_from_slice(MAGIC);\n    out.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(payload);\n}\n\n/// 编码单帧的便捷函数。\npub fn encode_vec(seq: u64, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(HEADER_LEN + payload.len());\n    encode(seq, payload, &mut out);\n    out\n}\n\n/// 从 `buf` 的起始位置解析一帧。\n///\n/// `at` 是该帧在段文件内的偏移（仅用于错误定位）。\npub fn decode_at(buf: &[u8], at: u64) -> Result<Frame, FrameError> {\n    // 短读：连帧头都不完整。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN {\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n    if &buf[0..4] != MAGIC {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"bad magic\" });\n    }\n    let seq = u64::from_le_bytes(buf[4..12].try_into().unwrap());\n    let len = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[12..16].try_into().unwrap());\n    let crc_stored = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[16..20].try_into().unwrap());\n\n    if len > MAX_PAYLOAD {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"payload length exceeds limit\" });\n    }\n    // 长度域指向帧边界之外：\n    // - 若声称的帧跨越文件实际结尾，属于长度域损坏（完整帧不可能这样）；\n    //   调用方需保证 buf 恰好是“本帧起、到文件尾”的剩余字节。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN + len as usize {\n        // 边界细分：文件尾只缺一部分。若长度域本身可疑（例如剩余字节连一个\n        // 合理帧都凑不齐），仍按损坏处理，因为短读只可能发生在“真实写入中断”，\n        // 而真实中断时长度域是完好的、文件在帧中部结束。\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n\n    let payload = &buf[20..20 + len as usize];\n    let mut crc_buf = Vec::with_capacity(12 + len as usize);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&buf[4..12]);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&buf[12..16]);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    if crc32(&crc_buf) != crc_stored {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"crc mismatch\" });\n    }\n\n    Ok(Frame { seq, payload: payload.to_vec() })\n}\n\n/// I/O 读取辅助：保证读满 `buf`，遇 EOF 返回 false（部分填充）。\npub fn read_exact_or_eof<R: io::Read>(r: &mut R, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<bool> {\n    let mut filled = 0;\n    while filled < buf.len() {\n        match r.read(&mut buf[filled..]) {\n            Ok(0) => return Ok(filled == 0 && false || false).map(|_| false).or_else(|_| {\n                if filled == 0 {\n                    Ok(false)\n                } else {\n                    // 不应到达：read 返回 0 且部分填充时统一在调用处按短读处理；\n                    // 这里把已填充长度留在 buf 中并通过特殊错误传回。\n                    Err(io::Error::new(\n                        io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                        PartialFill(filled),\n                    ))\n                }\n            }),\n            Ok(n) => filled += n,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}\n            Err(e) => return Err(e),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(true)\n}\n\n/// 内部：短读时携带已读字节数的 I/O 错误载荷。\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct PartialFill(usize);\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn round_trip() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(7, b\"abc\");\n        assert_eq!(raw.len(), HEADER_LEN + 3);\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 7);\n        assert_eq!(f.payload, b\"abc\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_payload() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(0, b\"\");\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 0);\n        assert!(f.payload.is_empty());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn header_short_read_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        for cut in 0..HEADER_LEN {\n            match decode_at(&raw[..cut], 0) {\n                Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, cut),\n                other => panic!(\"cut {cut}: expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn body_short_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        // 帧头完整但负载被切。\n        match decode_at(&raw[..HEADER_LEN + 2], 0) {\n            Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, HEADER_LEN + 2),\n            other => panic!(\"expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn payload_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        let last = raw.len() - 1;\n        raw[last] ^= 0x80; // 翻最后一个负载字节\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn seq_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[4] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn magic_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[0] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn len_field_flip_detected() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        // 把长度从 4 翻成一个大数：声称跨越边界。\n        raw[12] = 0xFF;\n        let res = decode_at(&raw, 0);\n        assert!(matches!(\n            res,\n            Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. }) | Err(FrameError::Truncated { .. })\n        ));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7d346aca-7fa9-4717-98d4-3bd5c93b28c2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

记录帧的磁盘封装格式。\n//!\n//! # 帧布局（小端序，共 20 + N 字节）\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! 偏移  长度  字段        说明\n//! 0     4     magic       固定 b\"SLG1\"，帧起始哨兵\n//! 4     8     seq         u64 单调递增记录序号（从 0 开始，逐条 +1）\n//! 12    4     payload_len u32 负载字节数 N\n//! 16    4     crc         CRC-32(seq_le || payload_len_le || payload)\n//! 20    N     payload     原始负载字节\n//! ```\n//!\n//! magic 不参与 CRC，是独立的帧哨兵；crc 覆盖 seq、长度与负载。\n//! 损坏任意字段都会被检出：\n//! - magic 翻位/长度域损坏导致读到非 `SLG1` 或长度越界 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - seq/负载翻位 -> CRC 不匹配 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - 文件在一帧写完前结束（短读）-> [`FrameError::Truncated`]，\n//!   恢复时仅允许这一种情况出现在最后一个段的尾部并被丢弃。\n\nuse crate::crc::crc32;\n\n/// 帧头长度：4 magic + 8 seq + 4 len + 4 crc。\npub const HEADER_LEN: usize = 20;\n/// 帧头魔数。\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b\"SLG1\";\n/// 单条负载的硬上限（16 MiB）。既是合理性检查，也防止损坏长度域触发巨量分配。\npub const MAX_PAYLOAD: u32 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// 单帧解析结果。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Frame {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 帧解析错误。\n#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FrameError {\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧内容不合法：\n    /// magic 错误、长度越界、CRC 不匹配等。恢复时视为中间损坏，必须报错。\n    Corrupt { at: u64, reason: &'static str },\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧在文件结束处被写了一半（短读）。\n    /// `present` 为从该帧起点算起实际存在的字节数。仅允许出现在最后一段尾部。\n    Truncated { at: u64, present: usize },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for FrameError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason } => {\n                write!(f, \"corrupt frame at offset {at}: {reason}\")\n            }\n            FrameError::Truncated { at, present } => {\n                write!(f, \"truncated frame tail at offset {at} ({present} trailing bytes)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for FrameError {}\n\n/// 将一条记录编码为一个完整帧，追加到 `out`。\npub fn encode(seq: u64, payload: &[u8], out: &mut Vec<u8>) {\n    assert!(\n        payload.len() <= MAX_PAYLOAD as usize,\n        \"payload exceeds {} bytes\",\n        MAX_PAYLOAD\n    );\n    let len = payload.len() as u32;\n    let crc = crc32(&encode_crc_region(seq, len, payload));\n\n    out.extend_from_slice(MAGIC);\n    out.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(payload);\n}\n\n/// 编码单帧的便捷函数。\npub fn encode_vec(seq: u64, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(HEADER_LEN + payload.len());\n    encode(seq, payload, &mut out);\n    out\n}\n\n/// 计算 CRC 覆盖区域：seq_le || len_le || payload。\nfn encode_crc_region(seq: u64, len: u32, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(12 + payload.len());\n    buf.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    buf.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    buf\n}\n\n/// 从 `buf` 的起始位置解析一帧。\n///\n/// `at` 是该帧在段文件内的偏移（仅用于错误定位）。\n/// 约定 `buf` 为“本帧起点到文件尾”的全部剩余字节，因此长度域指向\n/// 文件尾之外即可判定为尾部短读；但帧头中 magic 已损坏时返回 Corrupt。\npub fn decode_at(buf: &[u8], at: u64) -> Result<Frame, FrameError> {\n    // 短读：连帧头都不完整。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN {\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n    if &buf[0..4] != MAGIC {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"bad magic\" });\n    }\n    let seq = u64::from_le_bytes(buf[4..12].try_into().unwrap());\n    let len = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[12..16].try_into().unwrap());\n    let crc_stored = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[16..20].try_into().unwrap());\n\n    if len > MAX_PAYLOAD {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"payload length exceeds limit\" });\n    }\n    // 帧头声称的帧跨越实际文件尾：最后一帧写了一半。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN + len as usize {\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n\n    let payload = &buf[20..20 + len as usize];\n    let want_crc = crc32(&encode_crc_region(seq, len, payload));\n    if want_crc != crc_stored {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"crc mismatch\" });\n    }\n\n    Ok(Frame { seq, payload: payload.to_vec() })\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn round_trip() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(7, b\"abc\");\n        assert_eq!(raw.len(), HEADER_LEN + 3);\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 7);\n        assert_eq!(f.payload, b\"abc\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_payload() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(0, b\"\");\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 0);\n        assert!(f.payload.is_empty());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn header_short_read_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        for cut in 0..HEADER_LEN {\n            match decode_at(&raw[..cut], 0) {\n                Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, cut),\n                other => panic!(\"cut {cut}: expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn body_short_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        match decode_at(&raw[..HEADER_LEN + 2], 0) {\n            Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, HEADER_LEN + 2),\n            other => panic!(\"expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn payload_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        let last = raw.len() - 1;\n        raw[last] ^= 0x80;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn seq_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[4] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn crc_field_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[16] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn magic_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[0] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn len_field_flip_to_huge_is_truncated_or_corrupt() {\n        // 把长度从 4 翻成大数：声称跨越文件边界。\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[12] = 0xFF;\n        // 这种情形：长度指向 EOF 之外。语义上它可能是“长度域损坏”，\n        // 也可能是真实尾写中断。恢复器只在“最后一段尾部”接受 Truncated，\n        // 任何非尾部位置无论哪种都报错，二者都必须不是 Ok。\n        assert!(decode_at(&raw, 0).is_err());\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_fdcccaff176744c6c8041393","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1311,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":29496,"output_tokens":2608,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"87c9e50f-97fb-43f5-a0d4-9fc9b20b3cf5","timestamp":"2026-09-22T15:56:54.739Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

assert!(decode_at(&raw, 0).is_err());","     }"," }"]}],"originalFile":"//! 记录帧的磁盘封装格式。\n//!\n//! # 帧布局（小端序，共 20 + N 字节）\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! 偏移  长度  字段        说明\n//! 0     4     magic       固定 b\"SLG1\"，段起始/帧起始哨兵\n//! 4     8     seq         u64 单调递增记录序号（从 0 开始，逐条 +1）\n//! 12    4     payload_len u32 负载字节数 N\n//! 16    4     crc         CRC-32(seq_le || payload_len_le || payload)\n//! 20    N     payload     原始负载字节\n//! ```\n//!\n//! 注意：magic 不参与 CRC，它是独立的帧哨兵；crc 覆盖 seq、长度与负载。\n//! 损坏任意字段都会被检出：\n//! - magic 翻位/长度域损坏导致读到非 `SLG1` 或长度越界 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - seq/负载翻位 -> CRC 不匹配 -> [`FrameError::Corrupt`]；\n//! - 文件在一帧写完前结束（短读）-> [`FrameError::Truncated`]，\n//!   恢复时仅允许这一种情况出现在最后一个段的尾部并被丢弃。\n\nuse crate::crc::crc32;\nuse std::io;\n\n/// 帧头长度：4 magic + 8 seq + 4 len + 4 crc。\npub const HEADER_LEN: usize = 20;\n/// 帧头魔数。\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b\"SLG1\";\n/// 单条负载的硬上限（16 MiB）。既是合理性检查，也防止损坏长度域触发巨量分配。\npub const MAX_PAYLOAD: u32 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// 单帧解析结果。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Frame {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 帧解析错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum FrameError {\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧已完整（或长度声称完整）但内容不合法：\n    /// magic 错误、长度越界、CRC 不匹配等。恢复时视为中间损坏，必须报错。\n    Corrupt { at: u64, reason: &'static str },\n    /// 起始于段偏移 `at` 的帧在文件结束处被写了一半（短读）。\n    /// `present` 为实际读到的字节数。仅允许出现在最后一段尾部。\n    Truncated { at: u64, present: usize },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for FrameError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason } => {\n                write!(f, \"corrupt frame at offset {at}: {reason}\")\n            }\n            FrameError::Truncated { at, present } => {\n                write!(f, \"truncated frame tail at offset {at} ({present} trailing bytes)\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for FrameError {}\n\n/// 将一条记录编码为一个完整帧，追加到 `out`。\npub fn encode(seq: u64, payload: &[u8], out: &mut Vec<u8>) {\n    debug_assert!(payload.len() <= MAX_PAYLOAD as usize);\n    let len = payload.len() as u32;\n    let mut crc_buf = Vec::with_capacity(12 + payload.len());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    let crc = crc32(&crc_buf);\n\n    out.extend_from_slice(MAGIC);\n    out.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&len.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n    out.extend_from_slice(payload);\n}\n\n/// 编码单帧的便捷函数。\npub fn encode_vec(seq: u64, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(HEADER_LEN + payload.len());\n    encode(seq, payload, &mut out);\n    out\n}\n\n/// 从 `buf` 的起始位置解析一帧。\n///\n/// `at` 是该帧在段文件内的偏移（仅用于错误定位）。\npub fn decode_at(buf: &[u8], at: u64) -> Result<Frame, FrameError> {\n    // 短读：连帧头都不完整。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN {\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n    if &buf[0..4] != MAGIC {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"bad magic\" });\n    }\n    let seq = u64::from_le_bytes(buf[4..12].try_into().unwrap());\n    let len = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[12..16].try_into().unwrap());\n    let crc_stored = u32::from_le_bytes(buf[16..20].try_into().unwrap());\n\n    if len > MAX_PAYLOAD {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"payload length exceeds limit\" });\n    }\n    // 长度域指向帧边界之外：\n    // - 若声称的帧跨越文件实际结尾，属于长度域损坏（完整帧不可能这样）；\n    //   调用方需保证 buf 恰好是“本帧起、到文件尾”的剩余字节。\n    if buf.len() < HEADER_LEN + len as usize {\n        // 边界细分：文件尾只缺一部分。若长度域本身可疑（例如剩余字节连一个\n        // 合理帧都凑不齐），仍按损坏处理，因为短读只可能发生在“真实写入中断”，\n        // 而真实中断时长度域是完好的、文件在帧中部结束。\n        return Err(FrameError::Truncated { at, present: buf.len() });\n    }\n\n    let payload = &buf[20..20 + len as usize];\n    let mut crc_buf = Vec::with_capacity(12 + len as usize);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&buf[4..12]);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(&buf[12..16]);\n    crc_buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    if crc32(&crc_buf) != crc_stored {\n        return Err(FrameError::Corrupt { at, reason: \"crc mismatch\" });\n    }\n\n    Ok(Frame { seq, payload: payload.to_vec() })\n}\n\n/// I/O 读取辅助：保证读满 `buf`，遇 EOF 返回 false（部分填充）。\npub fn read_exact_or_eof<R: io::Read>(r: &mut R, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<bool> {\n    let mut filled = 0;\n    while filled < buf.len() {\n        match r.read(&mut buf[filled..]) {\n            Ok(0) => return Ok(filled == 0 && false || false).map(|_| false).or_else(|_| {\n                if filled == 0 {\n                    Ok(false)\n                } else {\n                    // 不应到达：read 返回 0 且部分填充时统一在调用处按短读处理；\n                    // 这里把已填充长度留在 buf 中并通过特殊错误传回。\n                    Err(io::Error::new(\n                        io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof,\n                        PartialFill(filled),\n                    ))\n                }\n            }),\n            Ok(n) => filled += n,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {}\n            Err(e) => return Err(e),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(true)\n}\n\n/// 内部：短读时携带已读字节数的 I/O 错误载荷。\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct PartialFill(usize);\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn round_trip() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(7, b\"abc\");\n        assert_eq!(raw.len(), HEADER_LEN + 3);\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 7);\n        assert_eq!(f.payload, b\"abc\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_payload() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(0, b\"\");\n        let f = decode_at(&raw, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(f.seq, 0);\n        assert!(f.payload.is_empty());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn header_short_read_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        for cut in 0..HEADER_LEN {\n            match decode_at(&raw[..cut], 0) {\n                Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, cut),\n                other => panic!(\"cut {cut}: expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn body_short_is_truncated() {\n        let raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        // 帧头完整但负载被切。\n        match decode_at(&raw[..HEADER_LEN + 2], 0) {\n            Err(FrameError::Truncated { present, .. }) => assert_eq!(present, HEADER_LEN + 2),\n            other => panic!(\"expected truncated, got {other:?}\"),\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn payload_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        let last = raw.len() - 1;\n        raw[last] ^= 0x80; // 翻最后一个负载字节\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn seq_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[4] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn magic_bit_flip_is_corrupt() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        raw[0] ^= 0x01;\n        assert!(matches!(decode_at(&raw, 0), Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. })));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn len_field_flip_detected() {\n        let mut raw = encode_vec(1, b\"abcd\");\n        // 把长度从 4 翻成一个大数：声称跨越边界。\n        raw[12] = 0xFF;\n        let res = decode_at(&raw, 0);\n        assert!(matches!(\n            res,\n            Err(FrameError::Corrupt { .. }) | Err(FrameError::Truncated { .. })\n        ));\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"87c9e50f-97fb-43f5-a0d4-9fc9b20b3cf5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

可注入的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库（[`crate::store`]）只依赖 [`Vfs`] trait，不直接调用 `std::fs`。\n//! - 生产环境使用 [`RealVfs`]：所有写操作都带 `fsync`，目录项变更后 fsync 父目录；\n//! - 测试使用 [`FaultyVfs`]：在真实磁盘上工作（故障效果跨“重启”可见），\n//!   但按脚本注入三类典型故障：撕裂写、sync 失败、rename 失败。\n//!\n//! 故障以“第 n 次某类操作”为触发条件，一次性生效，便于编写确定性测试。\n\nuse std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};\nuse std::io::{self, Write};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\n\n/// 存储库用到的全部文件系统原语。\npub trait Vfs: Send + Sync {\n    /// 整个文件读入内存（段文件不大；恢复与读取走这条路）。\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool;\n    /// 列出目录下的条目名（单层，非递归）。\n    fn list(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<String>>;\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n\n    /// 以 O_APPEND 方式追加并 `sync_all`。\n    fn append_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 以 O_CREATE|O_TRUNC 新建/覆写整个文件，写入并 `sync_all`。\n    fn create_truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 把文件截断到 `len` 字节并 `sync_all`。\n    fn truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// rename(2)。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 目录本身（让新建/重命名的目录项落盘）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// 直接落到真实磁盘的实现。\n#[derive(Default, Clone)]\npub struct RealVfs;\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        fs::read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.exists()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for e in fs::read_dir(dir)? {\n            out.push(e?.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned());\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::create_dir_all(dir)\n    }\n\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::remove_file(path)\n    }\n\n    fn append_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn create_truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let f = OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(path)?;\n        f.set_len(len)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            let f = File::open(dir)?;\n            f.sync_all()\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = dir;\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// rename 的目标类别，用于把故障精确注入到“段提交”或“索引提交”。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum RenameKind {\n    /// 目标是 `seg-XXXXXXXXXX.log`：段文件的原子提交。\n    Segment,\n    /// 目标是 `index.json`：索引更新。\n    Index,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障脚本，全部为“第 n 次调用时触发一次”。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 第 n 次 append：只把前 `keep_bytes` 字节写到文件末尾、不 sync，\n    /// 随后返回 I/O 错误。模拟进程在一次追加写中途崩溃（撕裂尾）。\n    TornAppend { nth: usize, keep_bytes: usize },\n    /// 第 n 次 append：连 write 都失败，文件内容不变。\n    FailAppendWrite { nth: usize },\n    /// 第 n 次 append：字节全部写出，但 `sync_all` 返回错误。\n    /// 字节实际上仍可能已落盘——与真实系统行为一致。\n    FailAppendSync { nth: usize },\n    /// 第 n 次指定类别的 rename 返回错误（源文件保留）。\n    FailRename { nth: usize, kind: RenameKind },\n}\n\n/// 包装真实磁盘 VFS 的故障注入层。\npub struct FaultyVfs {\n    inner: RealVfs,\n    faults: Mutex<Vec<Fault>>,\n    appends: Mutex<usize>,\n    renames: Mutex<usize>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultyVfs {\n    pub fn new(faults: Vec<Fault>) -> Self {\n        FaultyVfs {\n            inner: RealVfs::new(),\n            faults: Mutex::new(faults),\n            appends: Mutex::new(0),\n            renames: Mutex::new(0),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 取出并消费第一个满足谓词的故障（一次性触发）。\n    fn take<F: Fn(&Fault) -> bool>(&self, pred: F) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut g = self.faults.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(i) = g.iter().position(pred) {\n            Some(g.remove(i))\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn bump(c: &Mutex<usize>) -> usize {\n        let mut g = c.lock().unwrap();\n        *g += 1;\n        *g\n    }\n}\n\nfn sim_err(msg: &'static str) -> io::Error {\n    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, SimulatedFault(msg))\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct SimulatedFault(&'static str);\nimpl std::fmt::Display for SimulatedFault {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"simulated I/O fault: {}\", self.0)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for SimulatedFault {}\n\nimpl Vfs for FaultyVfs {\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.inner.read(path)\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn list(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list(dir)\n    }\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.create_dir_all(dir)\n    }\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.remove_file(path)\n    }\n\n    fn append_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = Self::bump(&self.appends);\n\n        if let Some(Fault::TornAppend { keep_bytes, .. }) =\n            self.take(|f| matches!(f, Fault::TornAppend { nth: n, .. } if *n == nth))\n        {\n            // 写一部分字节后“崩溃”：不 sync，直接报错。\n            let keep = keep_bytes.min(data.len());\n            let mut f = OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path)?;\n            f.write_all(&data[..keep])?;\n            return Err(sim_err(\"torn append (write crashed mid-frame)\"));\n        }\n        if self\n            .take(|f| matches!(f, Fault::FailAppendWrite { nth: n } if *n == nth))\n            .is_some()\n        {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,\n                SimulatedFault(\"append write failed\"),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        // 正常写字节。\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n\n        if self\n            .take(|f| matches!(f, Fault::FailAppendSync { nth: n } if *n == nth))\n            .is_some()\n        {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                SimulatedFault(\"fsync failed after append\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn create_truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.create_truncate_sync(path, data)\n    }\n\n    fn truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.truncate_sync(path, len)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = Self::bump(&self.renames);\n        let kind = classify_rename(to);\n        if self\n            .take(|f| {\n                matches!(f,\n                    Fault::FailRename { nth: n, kind: k }\n                    if *n == nth && *k == kind)\n            })\n            .is_some()\n        {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                SimulatedFault(\"rename failed\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_dir(dir)\n    }\n}\n\nfn classify_rename(to: &Path) -> RenameKind {\n    if to.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()) == Some(\"index.json\") {\n        RenameKind::Index\n    } else {\n        RenameKind::Segment\n    }\n}\n\n/// 测试辅助：在 `base` 下生成一个尚不存在的临时目录路径。\npub fn temp_dir(label: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\n    static N: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n    let n = N.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"seglog-{}-{}-{n}\",\n        label,\n        std::process::id()\n    ));\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&p).unwrap();\n    p\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c8b0d77fe2fa2c369098a883","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2918,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":30520,"output_tokens":8863,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"00589e57-a72a-4625-a279-30b845e3cf48","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:01:14.210Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

-> bool;\n    /// 列出目录下的条目名（单层，非递归）。\n    fn list(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<String>>;\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n\n    /// 以 O_APPEND 方式追加并 `sync_all`。\n    fn append_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 以 O_CREATE|O_TRUNC 新建/覆写整个文件，写入并 `sync_all`。\n    fn create_truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// 把文件截断到 `len` 字节并 `sync_all`。\n    fn truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// rename(2)。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// fsync 目录本身（让新建/重命名的目录项落盘）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n}\n\n/// 直接落到真实磁盘的实现。\n#[derive(Default, Clone)]\npub struct RealVfs;\n\nimpl RealVfs {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealVfs\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealVfs {\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        fs::read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        path.exists()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for e in fs::read_dir(dir)? {\n            out.push(e?.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned());\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::create_dir_all(dir)\n    }\n\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::remove_file(path)\n    }\n\n    fn append_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn create_truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new()\n            .create(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let f = OpenOptions::new().write(true).open(path)?;\n        f.set_len(len)?;\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            let f = File::open(dir)?;\n            f.sync_all()\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = dir;\n            Ok(())\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// rename 的目标类别，用于把故障精确注入到“段提交”或“索引提交”。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum RenameKind {\n    /// 目标是 `seg-XXXXXXXXXX.log`：段文件的原子提交。\n    Segment,\n    /// 目标是 `index.json`：索引更新。\n    Index,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障脚本，全部为“第 n 次调用时触发一次”。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 第 n 次 append：只把前 `keep_bytes` 字节写到文件末尾、不 sync，\n    /// 随后返回 I/O 错误。模拟进程在一次追加写中途崩溃（撕裂尾）。\n    TornAppend { nth: usize, keep_bytes: usize },\n    /// 第 n 次 append：连 write 都失败，文件内容不变。\n    FailAppendWrite { nth: usize },\n    /// 第 n 次 append：字节全部写出，但 `sync_all` 返回错误。\n    /// 字节实际上仍可能已落盘——与真实系统行为一致。\n    FailAppendSync { nth: usize },\n    /// 第 n 次指定类别的 rename 返回错误（源文件保留）。\n    FailRename { nth: usize, kind: RenameKind },\n}\n\n/// 包装真实磁盘 VFS 的故障注入层。\npub struct FaultyVfs {\n    inner: RealVfs,\n    faults: Mutex<Vec<Fault>>,\n    appends: Mutex<usize>,\n    renames: Mutex<usize>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultyVfs {\n    pub fn new(faults: Vec<Fault>) -> Self {\n        FaultyVfs {\n            inner: RealVfs::new(),\n            faults: Mutex::new(faults),\n            appends: Mutex::new(0),\n            renames: Mutex::new(0),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 取出并消费第一个满足谓词的故障（一次性触发）。\n    fn take<F: Fn(&Fault) -> bool>(&self, pred: F) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut g = self.faults.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(i) = g.iter().position(pred) {\n            Some(g.remove(i))\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn bump(c: &Mutex<usize>) -> usize {\n        let mut g = c.lock().unwrap();\n        *g += 1;\n        *g\n    }\n}\n\nfn sim_err(msg: &'static str) -> io::Error {\n    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, SimulatedFault(msg))\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct SimulatedFault(&'static str);\nimpl std::fmt::Display for SimulatedFault {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"simulated I/O fault: {}\", self.0)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for SimulatedFault {}\n\nimpl Vfs for FaultyVfs {\n    fn read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.inner.read(path)\n    }\n    fn exists(&self, path: &Path) -> bool {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn list(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list(dir)\n    }\n    fn create_dir_all(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.create_dir_all(dir)\n    }\n    fn remove_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.remove_file(path)\n    }\n\n    fn append_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = Self::bump(&self.appends);\n\n        if let Some(Fault::TornAppend { keep_bytes, .. }) =\n            self.take(|f| matches!(f, Fault::TornAppend { nth: n, .. } if *n == nth))\n        {\n            // 写一部分字节后“崩溃”：不 sync，直接报错。\n            let keep = keep_bytes.min(data.len());\n            let mut f = OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path)?;\n            f.write_all(&data[..keep])?;\n            return Err(sim_err(\"torn append (write crashed mid-frame)\"));\n        }\n        if self\n            .take(|f| matches!(f, Fault::FailAppendWrite { nth: n } if *n == nth))\n            .is_some()\n        {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,\n                SimulatedFault(\"append write failed\"),\n            ));\n        }\n\n        // 正常写字节。\n        let mut f = OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path)?;\n        f.write_all(data)?;\n\n        if self\n            .take(|f| matches!(f, Fault::FailAppendSync { nth: n } if *n == nth))\n            .is_some()\n        {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                SimulatedFault(\"fsync failed after append\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        f.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn create_truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.create_truncate_sync(path, data)\n    }\n\n    fn truncate_sync(&self, path: &Path, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.truncate_sync(path, len)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let nth = Self::bump(&self.renames);\n        let kind = classify_rename(to);\n        if self\n            .take(|f| {\n                matches!(f,\n                    Fault::FailRename { nth: n, kind: k }\n                    if *n == nth && *k == kind)\n            })\n            .is_some()\n        {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(\n                io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                SimulatedFault(\"rename failed\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self, dir: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_dir(dir)\n    }\n}\n\nfn classify_rename(to: &Path) -> RenameKind {\n    if to.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()) == Some(\"index.json\") {\n        RenameKind::Index\n    } else {\n        RenameKind::Segment\n    }\n}\n\n/// 测试辅助：在 `base` 下生成一个尚不存在的临时目录路径。\npub fn temp_dir(label: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\n    static N: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);\n    let n = N.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);\n    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"seglog-{}-{}-{n}\",\n        label,\n        std::process::id()\n    ));\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&p).unwrap();\n    p\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"00589e57-a72a-4625-a279-30b845e3cf48","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

{"parentUuid":"6f91ff33-340b-456d-85a1-20edb97c6dfb","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ybhbz7f9jhpejnj7wrz7ih7h","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b/src/store.rs","content":"//! 文件支持的分段追加日志存储库。\n//!\n//! ## 磁盘布局\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <dir>/\n//!   index.txt                 派生索引（可随时由段文件重建）\n//!   index.txt.tmp             索引原子更新临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n//!   seg-0000000000.log        段文件，id 为 10 位十进制、按 id 排序即时间顺序\n//!   seg-0000000001.log\n//!   seg-XXXXXXXXXX.log.tmp    轮转临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n//! ```\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（durability）\n//!\n//! - 每条记录：编码为一帧 → 单次 `write` 追加到活动段 → `fsync` 文件。\n//!   `append` 成功返回即该记录已确认（durable），且此前所有记录一并 durable。\n//! - 轮转：新建临时段并 fsync → `rename` 为正式段名 → fsync 父目录；\n//!   随后以 tmp+rename+fsyncdir 更新索引。\n//! - 索引是**派生状态**：open 时永远以段文件扫描结果为准重建/校正索引，\n//!   因此“段已提交但索引未更新”的崩溃窗口可恢复，索引丢失/损坏也可恢复。\n//!\n//! ## 恢复规则（open）\n//!\n//! 1. 按 id 依次扫描每个段；帧内 seq 必须全局连续（从 0 开始逐 1 递增，跨段连续）。\n//! 2. 仅允许**最后一个段**的**尾部**存在一帧写了一半的情况\n//!    （帧头不全 / 帧头完整但负载越过 EOF）：将文件截断到该帧起点丢弃之。\n//! 3. 以下情况一律返回错误，不丢数据：\n//!    - 任意位置 magic/CRC/长度域损坏（[`RecoverError::Corrupt`]）；\n//!    - 序号不连续（[`RecoverError::Sequence`]）；\n//!    - 非最后段尾部不完整（[`RecoverError::IncompleteSegment`]）。\n//! 4. 清理未提交的 `.tmp` 残留；索引缺失或与扫描不符则重写。\n\nuse crate::frame::{self, Frame, FrameError, HEADER_LEN};\nuse crate::io::Vfs;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 段文件名前缀与位数。\npub const SEG_PREFIX: &str = \"seg-\";\npub const SEG_SUFFIX: &str = \".log\";\npub const SEG_ID_WIDTH: usize = 10;\npub const INDEX_NAME: &str = \"index.txt\";\nconst INDEX_TMP: &str = \"index.txt.tmp\";\n\n/// 存储配置。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct StoreConfig {\n    /// 活动段大小阈值（字节）：append 后若超过该值则下一次 append 前自动轮转。\n    /// 0 表示不自动轮转。\n    pub max_segment_bytes: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Default for StoreConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 1024 * 1024 }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条已读出的记录。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Record {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub segment: u64,\n    /// 帧在段文件内的起始偏移。\n    pub offset: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 段的元数据（扫描得到）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct SegmentMeta {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub first_seq: Option<u64>,\n    pub last_seq: Option<u64>,\n    pub records: u64,\n    pub bytes: u64,\n}\n\n/// open 的结果报告。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct OpenReport {\n    pub recovered_records: u64,\n    pub segments: Vec<SegmentMeta>,\n    /// 若末段尾部被丢弃，给出段 id、截断位置与丢弃字节数。\n    pub truncated_tail: Option<TruncatedTail>,\n    /// 索引曾丢失/损坏/不一致并已重建。\n    pub index_repaired: bool,\n    /// 清理掉的未提交临时文件数。\n    pub removed_temps: usize,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct TruncatedTail {\n    pub segment: u64,\n    pub offset: u64,\n    pub dropped_bytes: u64,\n}\n\n/// append 成功返回。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Appended {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub segment: u64,\n    pub offset: u64,\n}\n\n/// rotate 成功返回。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Rotated {\n    pub new_segment: u64,\n}\n\n/// 恢复错误——硬错误，存储拒绝打开，避免静默丢数据。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum RecoverError {\n    Io(std::io::Error),\n    /// 段中段损坏（CRC/magic/长度）。任何段任何位置都不可接受。\n    Corrupt {\n        segment: u64,\n        offset: u64,\n        source: FrameError,\n    },\n    /// 序号缺失、重复或乱序。\n    Sequence {\n        segment: u64,\n        offset: u64,\n        expected: u64,\n        got: u64,\n    },\n    /// 非最后一个段以半帧结尾。\n    IncompleteSegment { segment: u64, offset: u64 },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for RecoverError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            RecoverError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"I/O error during recovery: {e}\"),\n            RecoverError::Corrupt { segment, offset, source } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"corruption in segment {segment} at offset {offset}: {source}; \\\n                 middle corruption is fatal, manual intervention required\"\n            ),\n            RecoverError::Sequence { segment, offset, expected, got } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"sequence break in segment {segment} at offset {offset}: \\\n                 expected seq {expected}, found {got}\"\n            ),\n            RecoverError::IncompleteSegment { segment, offset } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"non-final segment {segment} ends with a partial frame at offset {offset}\"\n            ),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for RecoverError {}\n\n/// 运行期错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    Io(std::io::Error),\n    /// 上一次 append 失败后状态不确定（可能尾部有半帧），必须重新 open 才能继续写。\n    Poisoned,\n    PayloadTooLarge { size: usize },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"I/O error: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::Poisoned => write!(\n                f,\n                \"store is poisoned after a failed append; reopen to recover the tail\"\n            ),\n            StoreError::PayloadTooLarge { size } => {\n                write!(f, \"payload of {size} bytes exceeds the frame limit\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\n\nimpl From<std::io::Error> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: std::io::Error) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\nimpl From<std::io::Error> for RecoverError {\n    fn from(e: std::io::Error) -> Self {\n        RecoverError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 文件支持的分段存储库。一个实例同时只允许一个写者（HTTP 层用 Mutex 保护）。\npub struct Store {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    config: StoreConfig,\n    active_id: u64,\n    active_bytes: u64,\n    next_seq: u64,\n    /// append 失败后置毒：拒绝后续写，直到重新 open。\n    poisoned: bool,\n}\n\n/// 单段扫描结果。\nstruct SegmentScan {\n    meta: SegmentMeta,\n    frames: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>, // (offset, payload)，含 seq 用 meta/帧本身\n    decoded: Vec<Frame>,\n    /// 完整帧覆盖的字节数；< 文件长度 表示尾部有半帧。\n    valid_len: usize,\n    tail: Option<FrameError>,\n}\n\nfn seg_name(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0SEG_ID_WIDTH$}{SEG_SUFFIX}\", id)\n}\n\nfn seg_tmp_name(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0SEG_ID_WIDTH$}{SEG_SUFFIX}.tmp\", id)\n}\n\nfn parse_seg_name(name: &str) -> Option<u64> {\n    let body = name\n        .strip_prefix(SEG_PREFIX)?\n        .strip_suffix(SEG_SUFFIX)?;\n    if body.len() != SEG_ID_WIDTH || !body.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {\n        return None;\n    }\n    body.parse().ok()\n}\n\nfn seg_path(dir: &Path, id: u64) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(seg_name(id))\n}\n\n/// 扫描一个段的字节，返回帧列表与有效长度。不在此处做序号检查。\nfn scan_segment(id: u64, data: &[u8]) -> Result<SegmentScan, RecoverError> {\n    let mut decoded = Vec::new();\n    let mut offsets = Vec::new();\n    let mut off = 0usize;\n    while off < data.len() {\n        match frame::decode_at(&data[off..], off as u64) {\n            Ok(f) => {\n                offsets.push(off as u64);\n                off += HEADER_LEN + f.payload.len();\n                decoded.push(f);\n            }\n            // 尾部半帧：记录后停止扫描。\n            Err(e @ FrameError::Truncated { .. }) => {\n                return Ok(SegmentScan {\n                    meta: SegmentMeta {\n                        id,\n                        first_seq: decoded.first().map(|f| f.seq),\n                        last_seq: decoded.last().map(|f| f.seq),\n                        records: decoded.len() as u64,\n                        bytes: off as u64,\n                    },\n                    frames: offsets\n                        .into_iter()\n                        .zip(decoded.iter().map(|f| f.payload.clone()))\n                        .collect(),\n                    decoded,\n                    valid_len: off,\n                    tail: Some(e),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(source) => {\n                return Err(RecoverError::Corrupt {\n                    segment: id,\n                    offset: off as u64,\n                    source,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(SegmentScan {\n        meta: SegmentMeta {\n            id,\n            first_seq: decoded.first().map(|f| f.seq),\n            last_seq: decoded.last().map(|f| f.seq),\n            records: decoded.len() as u64,\n            bytes: off as u64,\n        },\n        frames: offsets\n            .into_iter()\n            .zip(decoded.iter().map(|f| f.payload.clone()))\n            .collect(),\n        decoded,\n        valid_len: off,\n        tail: None,\n    })\n}\n\n/// 索引文本格式（见 README“磁盘格式”）。\nfn render_index(next_seq: u64, active: u64, metas: &[SegmentMeta]) -> String {\n    let mut s = String::new();\n    s.push_str(\"seg-log index v1\\n\");\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"next_seq={next_seq}\\n\"));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"active_segment={active}\\n\"));\n    for m in metas {\n        match (m.first_seq, m.last_seq) {\n            (Some(a), Some(b)) => {\n                s.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"segment={}:{}:{}:{}:{}\\n\",\n                    m.id, a, b, m.records, m.bytes\n                ));\n            }\n            _ => s.push_str(&format!(\"segment={}::-:0:{}\\n\", m.id, m.bytes)),\n        }\n    }\n    s\n}\n\n/// 解析索引；任何不符都返回 None（调用方据此重建）。\nfn parse_index(text: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64, Vec<SegmentMeta>)> {\n    let mut lines = text.lines();\n    if lines.next()? != \"seg-log index v1\" {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let mut next_seq = None;\n    let mut active = None;\n    let mut metas = Vec::new();\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"next_seq=\") {\n            next_seq = Some(v.parse().ok()?);\n        } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"active_segment=\") {\n            active = Some(v.parse().ok()?);\n        } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"segment=\") {\n            let mut it = v.split(':');\n            let id = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n            let first = it.next()?;\n            let last = it.next()?;\n            let records = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n            let bytes = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n            if it.next().is_some() {\n                return None;\n            }\n            let (first_seq, last_seq) = if first == \"-\" && last == \"-\" {\n                (None, None)\n            } else {\n                (Some(first.parse().ok()?), Some(last.parse().ok()?))\n            };\n            metas.push(SegmentMeta { id, first_seq, last_seq, records, bytes });\n        } else if line.is_empty() {\n            // 允许末尾空行\n        } else {\n            return None;\n        }\n    }\n    Some((next_seq?, active?, metas))\n}\n\nimpl Store {\n    /// 打开（必要时创建）存储库并执行恢复，详见模块文档。\n    pub fn open(\n        dir: impl AsRef<Path>,\n        vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n        config: StoreConfig,\n    ) -> Result<(Store, OpenReport), RecoverError> {\n        let dir = dir.as_ref().to_path_buf();\n        vfs.create_dir_all(&dir)?;\n\n        // 1) 清理未提交的临时文件。\n        let mut removed_temps = 0usize;\n        for name in vfs.list(&dir).unwrap_or_default() {\n            if name == INDEX_TMP\n                || (name.starts_with(SEG_PREFIX) && name.ends_with(\".log.tmp\"))\n            {\n                let _ = vfs.remove_file(&dir.join(&name));\n                removed_temps += 1;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 2) 列出全部正式段。\n        let mut ids: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();\n        for name in vfs.list(&dir)? {\n            if let Some(id) = parse_seg_name(&name) {\n                ids.push(id);\n            }\n        }\n        ids.sort_unstable();\n        ids.dedup();\n\n        // 3) 逐段扫描，校验“仅末段允许尾部半帧”与全局序号连续。\n        let mut metas = Vec::new();\n        let mut recovered_records = 0u64;\n        let mut truncated_tail = None;\n        let mut expected_seq = 0u64;\n\n        let last_id = ids.len().checked_sub(1);\n        for (idx, &id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {\n            let path = seg_path(&dir, id);\n            let data = vfs.read(&path)?;\n            let scan = scan_segment(id, &data)?;\n\n            if let Some(tail) = &scan.tail {\n                if Some(idx) != last_id {\n                    // 非最后段尾部不完整：硬错误。\n                    if let FrameError::Truncated { at, .. } = tail {\n                        return Err(RecoverError::IncompleteSegment {\n                            segment: id,\n                            offset: *at,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n                // 最后一段尾部半帧：截断丢弃。\n                if let FrameError::Truncated { at, present } = tail {\n                    let dropped = data.len() as u64 - *at;\n                    vfs.truncate_sync(&path, *at)?;\n                    truncated_tail = Some(TruncatedTail {\n                        segment: id,\n                        offset: *at,\n                        dropped_bytes: dropped,\n                    });\n                    let _ = present; // present = data.len()-at，含义同 dropped\n                }\n            }\n\n            for f in &scan.decoded {\n                if f.seq != expected_seq {\n                    return Err(RecoverError::Sequence {\n                        segment: id,\n                        offset: 0,\n                        expected: expected_seq,\n                        got: f.seq,\n                    });\n                }\n                expected_seq += 1;\n            }\n            recovered_records += scan.decoded.len() as u64;\n            metas.push(scan.meta);\n        }\n\n        // 4) 空存储：创建第 0 段。\n        let active_id = match ids.last() {\n            Some(&id) => id,\n            None => {\n                let p = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n                vfs.create_truncate_sync(&p, &[])?;\n                vfs.sync_dir(&dir)?;\n                metas.push(SegmentMeta {\n                    id: 0,\n                    first_seq: None,\n                    last_seq: None,\n                    records: 0,\n                    bytes: 0,\n                });\n                0u64\n            }\n        };\n        let active_bytes = metas.iter().find(|m| m.id == active_id).map(|m| m.bytes).unwrap_or(0);\n\n        // 5) 索引核对 / 重建（派生状态）。\n        let index_path = dir.join(INDEX_NAME);\n        let want_index = render_index(expected_seq, active_id, &metas);\n        let mut index_repaired = false;\n        let on_disk = vfs.read(&index_path).ok();\n        match on_disk {\n            Some(bytes) if bytes == want_index.as_bytes() => {}\n            _ => {\n                Self::write_index(&vfs, &dir, want_index.as_bytes())?;\n                index_repaired = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        let store = Store {\n            dir,\n            vfs,\n            config,\n            active_id,\n            active_bytes,\n            next_seq: expected_seq,\n            poisoned: false,\n        };\n        let report = OpenReport {\n            recovered_records,\n            segments: metas,\n            truncated_tail,\n            index_repaired,\n            removed_temps,\n        };\n        Ok((store, report))\n    }\n\n    /// tmp + rename + fsync(dir) 原子替换索引。\n    fn write_index(vfs: &Arc<dyn Vfs>, dir: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<(), RecoverError> {\n        let tmp = dir.join(INDEX_TMP);\n        vfs.create_truncate_sync(&tmp, data)?;\n        vfs.rename(&tmp, &dir.join(INDEX_NAME))?;\n        vfs.sync_dir(dir)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn active_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        seg_path(&self.dir, self.active_id)\n    }\n\n    /// 下一条记录序号。\n    pub fn next_seq(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.next_seq\n    }\n\n    /// 当前活动段 id。\n    pub fn active_segment(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.active_id\n    }\n\n    /// 存储是否处于“写失败后需重开”状态。\n    pub fn is_poisoned(&self) -> bool {\n        self.poisoned\n    }\n\n    /// 活动段当前字节数。\n    pub fn active_bytes(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.active_bytes\n    }\n\n    /// 追加一条记录；成功即 fsync 完成（见模块级“同步边界”）。\n    pub fn append(&mut self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Appended, StoreError> {\n        if self.poisoned {\n            return Err(StoreError::Poisoned);\n        }\n        if payload.len() > frame::MAX_PAYLOAD as usize {\n            return Err(StoreError::PayloadTooLarge { size: payload.len() });\n        }\n\n        // 自动轮转：活动段非空且加入本帧后越过阈值。\n        let frame_len = (HEADER_LEN + payload.len()) as u64;\n        if self.config.max_segment_bytes > 0\n            && self.active_bytes > 0\n            && self.active_bytes + frame_len > self.config.max_segment_bytes\n        {\n            self.rotate()?;\n        }\n\n        let seq = self.next_seq;\n        let segment = self.active_id;\n        let offset = self.active_bytes;\n        let frame = frame::encode_vec(seq, payload);\n\n        // 关键写：任何错误都置毒——成功与否外界已无法从进程内判定，\n        // 必须重新 open 走恢复，杜绝在可能的半帧之后继续追加。\n        if let Err(e) = self.vfs.append_sync(&self.active_path(), &frame) {\n            self.poisoned = true;\n            return Err(StoreError::Io(e));\n        }\n\n        self.next_seq += 1;\n        self.active_bytes += frame_len;\n        Ok(Appended { seq, segment, offset })\n    }\n\n    /// 显式轮转：当前段非空时提交下一个空段并更新索引。\n    pub fn rotate(&mut self) -> Result<Rotated, StoreError> {\n        if self.poisoned {\n            return Err(StoreError::Poisoned);\n        }\n        if self.active_bytes == 0 {\n            return Ok(Rotated { new_segment: self.active_id });\n        }\n        let new_id = self.active_id + 1;\n        let tmp = self.dir.join(seg_tmp_name(new_id));\n        let final_path = seg_path(&self.dir, new_id);\n\n        // 1) 临时文件落盘。\n        self.vfs.create_truncate_sync(&tmp, &[])?;\n        // 2) 原子改名；失败则清理临时文件，活动段不变，不置毒（无不确定状态）。\n        if let Err(e) = self.vfs.rename(&tmp, &final_path) {\n            let _ = self.vfs.remove_file(&tmp);\n            return Err(StoreError::Io(e));\n        }\n        // 3) 目录项落盘。\n        self.vfs.sync_dir(&self.dir)?;\n\n        // 更新内存中的段表（用于索引渲染）：读旧索引不如直接重扫一次简单，\n        // 但段表只在 open 时持有；这里直接列出并扫描成本不必要，\n        // 改为：从磁盘重建 metas 仅在写索引时做。\n        self.active_id = new_id;\n        self.active_bytes = 0;\n\n        // 4) 更新索引（段文件本身已是事实来源；索引更新失败不影响数据，\n        //    下次 open 会补上——但仍把错误返回给调用方以便观测）。\n        self.refresh_index()?;\n        Ok(Rotated { new_segment: new_id })\n    }\n\n    /// 重新扫描段并把索引写到与磁盘一致。\n    fn refresh_index(&mut self) -> Result<(), StoreError> {\n        let metas = self.scan_metas()?;\n        let data = render_index(self.next_seq, self.active_id, &metas);\n        Self::write_index(&self.vfs, &self.dir, data.as_bytes())\n            .map_err(StoreError::from)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn scan_metas(&self) -> Result<Vec<SegmentMeta>, StoreError> {\n        let mut names = self.vfs.list(&self.dir)?;\n        names.retain(|n| parse_seg_name(n).is_some());\n        names.sort();\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for n in names {\n            let id = parse_seg_name(&n).unwrap();\n            let data = self.vfs.read(&self.dir.join(&n))?;\n            let scan = scan_segment(id, &data).map_err(|_| {\n                StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    \"segment became unreadable\",\n                ))\n            })?;\n            out.push(scan.meta);\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    /// 读取全部记录（按 seq 顺序）。运行期数据应始终完好；\n    /// 若读到损坏同样以错误返回，绝不跳过。\n    pub fn read_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Record>, StoreError> {\n        let mut names = self.vfs.list(&self.dir)?;\n        names.retain(|n| parse_seg_name(n).is_some());\n        names.sort();\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let mut expected = 0u64;\n        for n in names {\n            let id = parse_seg_name(&n).unwrap();\n            let data = self.vfs.read(&self.dir.join(&n))?;\n            let scan = scan_segment(id, &data).map_err(|_| {\n                StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    \"corrupt segment while reading\",\n                ))\n            })?;\n            if scan.tail.is_some() {\n                return Err(StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    \"active segment unexpectedly contains a partial frame\",\n                )));\n            }\n            for (f, off) in scan.decoded.iter().zip(scan.frames.iter().map(|x| x.0)) {\n                if f.seq != expected {\n                    return Err(StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                        std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                        format!(\"sequence gap: expected {expected}, got {}\", f.seq),\n                    )));\n                }\n                out.push(Record {\n                    seq: f.seq,\n                    segment: id,\n                    offset: off,\n                    payload: f.payload.clone(),\n                });\n                expected += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    /// 当前状态摘要（HTTP /status 用）。\n    pub fn status(&self) ->
