文件支持的分段追加日志存储库。\n//!\n//! ## 磁盘布局\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <dir>/\n//!   index.txt                 派生索引（可随时由段文件重建）\n//!   index.txt.tmp             索引原子更新临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n//!   seg-0000000000.log        段文件，id 为 10 位十进制、按 id 排序即时间顺序\n//!   seg-0000000001.log\n//!   seg-XXXXXXXXXX.log.tmp    轮转临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n//! ```\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（durability）\n//!\n//! - 每条记录：编码为一帧 → 单次 `write` 追加到活动段 → `fsync` 文件。\n//!   `append` 成功返回即该记录已确认（durable），且此前所有记录一并 durable。\n//! - 轮转：新建临时段并 fsync → `rename` 为正式段名 → fsync 父目录；\n//!   随后以 tmp+rename+fsyncdir 更新索引。\n//! - 索引是**派生状态**：open 时永远以段文件扫描结果为准重建/校正索引，\n//!   因此“段已提交但索引未更新”的崩溃窗口可恢复，索引丢失/损坏也可恢复。\n//!\n//! ## 恢复规则（open）\n//!\n//! 1. 按 id 依次扫描每个段；帧内 seq 必须全局连续（从 0 开始逐 1 递增，跨段连续）。\n//! 2. 仅允许**最后一个段**的**尾部**存在一帧写了一半的情况\n//!    （帧头不全 / 帧头完整但负载越过 EOF）：将文件截断到该帧起点丢弃之。\n//! 3. 以下情况一律返回错误，不丢数据：\n//!    - 任意位置 magic/CRC/长度域损坏（[`RecoverError::Corrupt`]）；\n//!    - 序号不连续（[`RecoverError::Sequence`]）；\n//!    - 非最后段尾部不完整（[`RecoverError::IncompleteSegment`]）。\n//! 4. 清理未提交的 `.tmp` 残留；索引缺失或与扫描不符则重写。\n\nuse crate::frame::{self, Frame, FrameError, HEADER_LEN};\nuse crate::io::Vfs;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// 段文件名前缀与位数。\npub const SEG_PREFIX: &str = \"seg-\";\npub const SEG_SUFFIX: &str = \".log\";\npub const SEG_ID_WIDTH: usize = 10;\npub const INDEX_NAME: &str = \"index.txt\";\nconst INDEX_TMP: &str = \"index.txt.tmp\";\n\n/// 存储配置。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct StoreConfig {\n    /// 活动段大小阈值（字节）：append 后若超过该值则下一次 append 前自动轮转。\n    /// 0 表示不自动轮转。\n    pub max_segment_bytes: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Default for StoreConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 1024 * 1024 }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条已读出的记录。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Record {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub segment: u64,\n    /// 帧在段文件内的起始偏移。\n    pub offset: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 段的元数据（扫描得到）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct SegmentMeta {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub first_seq: Option<u64>,\n    pub last_seq: Option<u64>,\n    pub records: u64,\n    pub bytes: u64,\n}\n\n/// open 的结果报告。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct OpenReport {\n    pub recovered_records: u64,\n    pub segments: Vec<SegmentMeta>,\n    /// 若末段尾部被丢弃，给出段 id、截断位置与丢弃字节数。\n    pub truncated_tail: Option<TruncatedTail>,\n    /// 索引曾丢失/损坏/不一致并已重建。\n    pub index_repaired: bool,\n    /// 清理掉的未提交临时文件数。\n    pub removed_temps: usize,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct TruncatedTail {\n    pub segment: u64,\n    pub offset: u64,\n    pub dropped_bytes: u64,\n}\n\n/// append 成功返回。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Appended {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub segment: u64,\n    pub offset: u64,\n}\n\n/// rotate 成功返回。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Rotated {\n    pub new_segment: u64,\n}\n\n/// 恢复错误——硬错误，存储拒绝打开，避免静默丢数据。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum RecoverError {\n    Io(std::io::Error),\n    /// 段中段损坏（CRC/magic/长度）。任何段任何位置都不可接受。\n    Corrupt {\n        segment: u64,\n        offset: u64,\n        source: FrameError,\n    },\n    /// 序号缺失、重复或乱序。\n    Sequence {\n        segment: u64,\n        offset: u64,\n        expected: u64,\n        got: u64,\n    },\n    /// 非最后一个段以半帧结尾。\n    IncompleteSegment { segment: u64, offset: u64 },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for RecoverError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            RecoverError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"I/O error during recovery: {e}\"),\n            RecoverError::Corrupt { segment, offset, source } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"corruption in segment {segment} at offset {offset}: {source}; \\\n                 middle corruption is fatal, manual intervention required\"\n            ),\n            RecoverError::Sequence { segment, offset, expected, got } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"sequence break in segment {segment} at offset {offset}: \\\n                 expected seq {expected}, found {got}\"\n            ),\n            RecoverError::IncompleteSegment { segment, offset } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"non-final segment {segment} ends with a partial frame at offset {offset}\"\n            ),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for RecoverError {}\n\n/// 运行期错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum StoreError {\n    Io(std::io::Error),\n    /// 上一次 append 失败后状态不确定（可能尾部有半帧），必须重新 open 才能继续写。\n    Poisoned,\n    PayloadTooLarge { size: usize },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"I/O error: {e}\"),\n            StoreError::Poisoned => write!(\n                f,\n                \"store is poisoned after a failed append; reopen to recover the tail\"\n            ),\n            StoreError::PayloadTooLarge { size } => {\n                write!(f, \"payload of {size} bytes exceeds the frame limit\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\n\nimpl From<std::io::Error> for StoreError {\n    fn from(e: std::io::Error) -> Self {\n        StoreError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\nimpl From<std::io::Error> for RecoverError {\n    fn from(e: std::io::Error) -> Self {\n        RecoverError::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 文件支持的分段存储库。一个实例同时只允许一个写者（HTTP 层用 Mutex 保护）。\npub struct Store {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n    config: StoreConfig,\n    active_id: u64,\n    active_bytes: u64,\n    next_seq: u64,\n    /// append 失败后置毒：拒绝后续写，直到重新 open。\n    poisoned: bool,\n}\n\n/// 单段扫描结果。\nstruct SegmentScan {\n    meta: SegmentMeta,\n    frames: Vec<(u64, Vec<u8>)>, // (offset, payload)，含 seq 用 meta/帧本身\n    decoded: Vec<Frame>,\n    /// 完整帧覆盖的字节数；< 文件长度 表示尾部有半帧。\n    valid_len: usize,\n    tail: Option<FrameError>,\n}\n\nfn seg_name(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0SEG_ID_WIDTH$}{SEG_SUFFIX}\", id)\n}\n\nfn seg_tmp_name(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0SEG_ID_WIDTH$}{SEG_SUFFIX}.tmp\", id)\n}\n\nfn parse_seg_name(name: &str) -> Option<u64> {\n    let body = name\n        .strip_prefix(SEG_PREFIX)?\n        .strip_suffix(SEG_SUFFIX)?;\n    if body.len() != SEG_ID_WIDTH || !body.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {\n        return None;\n    }\n    body.parse().ok()\n}\n\nfn seg_path(dir: &Path, id: u64) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(seg_name(id))\n}\n\n/// 扫描一个段的字节，返回帧列表与有效长度。不在此处做序号检查。\nfn scan_segment(id: u64, data: &[u8]) -> Result<SegmentScan, RecoverError> {\n    let mut decoded = Vec::new();\n    let mut offsets = Vec::new();\n    let mut off = 0usize;\n    while off < data.len() {\n        match frame::decode_at(&data[off..], off as u64) {\n            Ok(f) => {\n                offsets.push(off as u64);\n                off += HEADER_LEN + f.payload.len();\n                decoded.push(f);\n            }\n            // 尾部半帧：记录后停止扫描。\n            Err(e @ FrameError::Truncated { .. }) => {\n                return Ok(SegmentScan {\n                    meta: SegmentMeta {\n                        id,\n                        first_seq: decoded.first().map(|f| f.seq),\n                        last_seq: decoded.last().map(|f| f.seq),\n                        records: decoded.len() as u64,\n                        bytes: off as u64,\n                    },\n                    frames: offsets\n                        .into_iter()\n                        .zip(decoded.iter().map(|f| f.payload.clone()))\n                        .collect(),\n                    decoded,\n                    valid_len: off,\n                    tail: Some(e),\n                });\n            }\n            Err(source) => {\n                return Err(RecoverError::Corrupt {\n                    segment: id,\n                    offset: off as u64,\n                    source,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(SegmentScan {\n        meta: SegmentMeta {\n            id,\n            first_seq: decoded.first().map(|f| f.seq),\n            last_seq: decoded.last().map(|f| f.seq),\n            records: decoded.len() as u64,\n            bytes: off as u64,\n        },\n        frames: offsets\n            .into_iter()\n            .zip(decoded.iter().map(|f| f.payload.clone()))\n            .collect(),\n        decoded,\n        valid_len: off,\n        tail: None,\n    })\n}\n\n/// 索引文本格式（见 README“磁盘格式”）。\nfn render_index(next_seq: u64, active: u64, metas: &[SegmentMeta]) -> String {\n    let mut s = String::new();\n    s.push_str(\"seg-log index v1\\n\");\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"next_seq={next_seq}\\n\"));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"active_segment={active}\\n\"));\n    for m in metas {\n        match (m.first_seq, m.last_seq) {\n            (Some(a), Some(b)) => {\n                s.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"segment={}:{}:{}:{}:{}\\n\",\n                    m.id, a, b, m.records, m.bytes\n                ));\n            }\n            _ => s.push_str(&format!(\"segment={}::-:0:{}\\n\", m.id, m.bytes)),\n        }\n    }\n    s\n}\n\n/// 解析索引；任何不符都返回 None（调用方据此重建）。\nfn parse_index(text: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64, Vec<SegmentMeta>)> {\n    let mut lines = text.lines();\n    if lines.next()? != \"seg-log index v1\" {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let mut next_seq = None;\n    let mut active = None;\n    let mut metas = Vec::new();\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"next_seq=\") {\n            next_seq = Some(v.parse().ok()?);\n        } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"active_segment=\") {\n            active = Some(v.parse().ok()?);\n        } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"segment=\") {\n            let mut it = v.split(':');\n            let id = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n            let first = it.next()?;\n            let last = it.next()?;\n            let records = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n            let bytes = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n            if it.next().is_some() {\n                return None;\n            }\n            let (first_seq, last_seq) = if first == \"-\" && last == \"-\" {\n                (None, None)\n            } else {\n                (Some(first.parse().ok()?), Some(last.parse().ok()?))\n            };\n            metas.push(SegmentMeta { id, first_seq, last_seq, records, bytes });\n        } else if line.is_empty() {\n            // 允许末尾空行\n        } else {\n            return None;\n        }\n    }\n    Some((next_seq?, active?, metas))\n}\n\nimpl Store {\n    /// 打开（必要时创建）存储库并执行恢复，详见模块文档。\n    pub fn open(\n        dir: impl AsRef<Path>,\n        vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n        config: StoreConfig,\n    ) -> Result<(Store, OpenReport), RecoverError> {\n        let dir = dir.as_ref().to_path_buf();\n        vfs.create_dir_all(&dir)?;\n\n        // 1) 清理未提交的临时文件。\n        let mut removed_temps = 0usize;\n        for name in vfs.list(&dir).unwrap_or_default() {\n            if name == INDEX_TMP\n                || (name.starts_with(SEG_PREFIX) && name.ends_with(\".log.tmp\"))\n            {\n                let _ = vfs.remove_file(&dir.join(&name));\n                removed_temps += 1;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 2) 列出全部正式段。\n        let mut ids: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();\n        for name in vfs.list(&dir)? {\n            if let Some(id) = parse_seg_name(&name) {\n                ids.push(id);\n            }\n        }\n        ids.sort_unstable();\n        ids.dedup();\n\n        // 3) 逐段扫描，校验“仅末段允许尾部半帧”与全局序号连续。\n        let mut metas = Vec::new();\n        let mut recovered_records = 0u64;\n        let mut truncated_tail = None;\n        let mut expected_seq = 0u64;\n\n        let last_id = ids.len().checked_sub(1);\n        for (idx, &id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {\n            let path = seg_path(&dir, id);\n            let data = vfs.read(&path)?;\n            let scan = scan_segment(id, &data)?;\n\n            if let Some(tail) = &scan.tail {\n                if Some(idx) != last_id {\n                    // 非最后段尾部不完整：硬错误。\n                    if let FrameError::Truncated { at, .. } = tail {\n                        return Err(RecoverError::IncompleteSegment {\n                            segment: id,\n                            offset: *at,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n                // 最后一段尾部半帧：截断丢弃。\n                if let FrameError::Truncated { at, present } = tail {\n                    let dropped = data.len() as u64 - *at;\n                    vfs.truncate_sync(&path, *at)?;\n                    truncated_tail = Some(TruncatedTail {\n                        segment: id,\n                        offset: *at,\n                        dropped_bytes: dropped,\n                    });\n                    let _ = present; // present = data.len()-at，含义同 dropped\n                }\n            }\n\n            for f in &scan.decoded {\n                if f.seq != expected_seq {\n                    return Err(RecoverError::Sequence {\n                        segment: id,\n                        offset: 0,\n                        expected: expected_seq,\n                        got: f.seq,\n                    });\n                }\n                expected_seq += 1;\n            }\n            recovered_records += scan.decoded.len() as u64;\n            metas.push(scan.meta);\n        }\n\n        // 4) 空存储：创建第 0 段。\n        let active_id = match ids.last() {\n            Some(&id) => id,\n            None => {\n                let p = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n                vfs.create_truncate_sync(&p, &[])?;\n                vfs.sync_dir(&dir)?;\n                metas.push(SegmentMeta {\n                    id: 0,\n                    first_seq: None,\n                    last_seq: None,\n                    records: 0,\n                    bytes: 0,\n                });\n                0u64\n            }\n        };\n        let active_bytes = metas.iter().find(|m| m.id == active_id).map(|m| m.bytes).unwrap_or(0);\n\n        // 5) 索引核对 / 重建（派生状态）。\n        let index_path = dir.join(INDEX_NAME);\n        let want_index = render_index(expected_seq, active_id, &metas);\n        let mut index_repaired = false;\n        let on_disk = vfs.read(&index_path).ok();\n        match on_disk {\n            Some(bytes) if bytes == want_index.as_bytes() => {}\n            _ => {\n                Self::write_index(&vfs, &dir, want_index.as_bytes())?;\n                index_repaired = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        let store = Store {\n            dir,\n            vfs,\n            config,\n            active_id,\n            active_bytes,\n            next_seq: expected_seq,\n            poisoned: false,\n        };\n        let report = OpenReport {\n            recovered_records,\n            segments: metas,\n            truncated_tail,\n            index_repaired,\n            removed_temps,\n        };\n        Ok((store, report))\n    }\n\n    /// tmp + rename + fsync(dir) 原子替换索引。\n    fn write_index(vfs: &Arc<dyn Vfs>, dir: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<(), RecoverError> {\n        let tmp = dir.join(INDEX_TMP);\n        vfs.create_truncate_sync(&tmp, data)?;\n        vfs.rename(&tmp, &dir.join(INDEX_NAME))?;\n        vfs.sync_dir(dir)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn active_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        seg_path(&self.dir, self.active_id)\n    }\n\n    /// 下一条记录序号。\n    pub fn next_seq(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.next_seq\n    }\n\n    /// 当前活动段 id。\n    pub fn active_segment(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.active_id\n    }\n\n    /// 存储是否处于“写失败后需重开”状态。\n    pub fn is_poisoned(&self) -> bool {\n        self.poisoned\n    }\n\n    /// 活动段当前字节数。\n    pub fn active_bytes(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.active_bytes\n    }\n\n    /// 追加一条记录；成功即 fsync 完成（见模块级“同步边界”）。\n    pub fn append(&mut self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Appended, StoreError> {\n        if self.poisoned {\n            return Err(StoreError::Poisoned);\n        }\n        if payload.len() > frame::MAX_PAYLOAD as usize {\n            return Err(StoreError::PayloadTooLarge { size: payload.len() });\n        }\n\n        // 自动轮转：活动段非空且加入本帧后越过阈值。\n        let frame_len = (HEADER_LEN + payload.len()) as u64;\n        if self.config.max_segment_bytes > 0\n            && self.active_bytes > 0\n            && self.active_bytes + frame_len > self.config.max_segment_bytes\n        {\n            self.rotate()?;\n        }\n\n        let seq = self.next_seq;\n        let segment = self.active_id;\n        let offset = self.active_bytes;\n        let frame = frame::encode_vec(seq, payload);\n\n        // 关键写：任何错误都置毒——成功与否外界已无法从进程内判定，\n        // 必须重新 open 走恢复，杜绝在可能的半帧之后继续追加。\n        if let Err(e) = self.vfs.append_sync(&self.active_path(), &frame) {\n            self.poisoned = true;\n            return Err(StoreError::Io(e));\n        }\n\n        self.next_seq += 1;\n        self.active_bytes += frame_len;\n        Ok(Appended { seq, segment, offset })\n    }\n\n    /// 显式轮转：当前段非空时提交下一个空段并更新索引。\n    pub fn rotate(&mut self) -> Result<Rotated, StoreError> {\n        if self.poisoned {\n            return Err(StoreError::Poisoned);\n        }\n        if self.active_bytes == 0 {\n            return Ok(Rotated { new_segment: self.active_id });\n        }\n        let new_id = self.active_id + 1;\n        let tmp = self.dir.join(seg_tmp_name(new_id));\n        let final_path = seg_path(&self.dir, new_id);\n\n        // 1) 临时文件落盘。\n        self.vfs.create_truncate_sync(&tmp, &[])?;\n        // 2) 原子改名；失败则清理临时文件，活动段不变，不置毒（无不确定状态）。\n        if let Err(e) = self.vfs.rename(&tmp, &final_path) {\n            let _ = self.vfs.remove_file(&tmp);\n            return Err(StoreError::Io(e));\n        }\n        // 3) 目录项落盘。\n        self.vfs.sync_dir(&self.dir)?;\n\n        // 更新内存中的段表（用于索引渲染）：读旧索引不如直接重扫一次简单，\n        // 但段表只在 open 时持有；这里直接列出并扫描成本不必要，\n        // 改为：从磁盘重建 metas 仅在写索引时做。\n        self.active_id = new_id;\n        self.active_bytes = 0;\n\n        // 4) 更新索引（段文件本身已是事实来源；索引更新失败不影响数据，\n        //    下次 open 会补上——但仍把错误返回给调用方以便观测）。\n        self.refresh_index()?;\n        Ok(Rotated { new_segment: new_id })\n    }\n\n    /// 重新扫描段并把索引写到与磁盘一致。\n    fn refresh_index(&mut self) -> Result<(), StoreError> {\n        let metas = self.scan_metas()?;\n        let data = render_index(self.next_seq, self.active_id, &metas);\n        Self::write_index(&self.vfs, &self.dir, data.as_bytes())\n            .map_err(StoreError::from)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn scan_metas(&self) -> Result<Vec<SegmentMeta>, StoreError> {\n        let mut names = self.vfs.list(&self.dir)?;\n        names.retain(|n| parse_seg_name(n).is_some());\n        names.sort();\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for n in names {\n            let id = parse_seg_name(&n).unwrap();\n            let data = self.vfs.read(&self.dir.join(&n))?;\n            let scan = scan_segment(id, &data).map_err(|_| {\n                StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    \"segment became unreadable\",\n                ))\n            })?;\n            out.push(scan.meta);\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    /// 读取全部记录（按 seq 顺序）。运行期数据应始终完好；\n    /// 若读到损坏同样以错误返回，绝不跳过。\n    pub fn read_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Record>, StoreError> {\n        let mut names = self.vfs.list(&self.dir)?;\n        names.retain(|n| parse_seg_name(n).is_some());\n        names.sort();\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let mut expected = 0u64;\n        for n in names {\n            let id = parse_seg_name(&n).unwrap();\n            let data = self.vfs.read(&self.dir.join(&n))?;\n            let scan = scan_segment(id, &data).map_err(|_| {\n                StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    \"corrupt segment while reading\",\n                ))\n            })?;\n            if scan.tail.is_some() {\n                return Err(StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                    \"active segment unexpectedly contains a partial frame\",\n                )));\n            }\n            for (f, off) in scan.decoded.iter().zip(scan.frames.iter().map(|x| x.0)) {\n                if f.seq != expected {\n                    return Err(StoreError::Io(std::io::Error::new(\n                        std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                        format!(\"sequence gap: expected {expected}, got {}\", f.seq),\n                    )));\n                }\n                out.push(Record {\n                    seq: f.seq,\n                    segment: id,\n                    offset: off,\n                    payload: f.payload.clone(),\n                });\n                expected += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    /// 当前状态摘要（HTTP /status 用）。\n    pub fn status(&self) -> Status {\n        Status {\n            next_seq: self.next_seq,\n            active_segment: self.active_id,\n            active_bytes: self.active_bytes,\n            poisoned: self.poisoned,\n            max_segment_bytes: self.config.max_segment_bytes,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct Status {\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    pub active_segment: u64,\n    pub active_bytes: u64,\n    pub poisoned: bool,\n    pub max_segment_bytes: u64,\n}\n\n/// 线程安全句柄类型别名（HTTP 层使用）。\npub type SharedStore = {"parentUuid":"b7e91aa0-0f11-434d-b318-56e9eb6f5683","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_kiicpo5div2u8l6hs9kpll8s","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b/src/server.rs","content":"//! 本地 HTTP 验证入口（仅用于本机验收，无鉴权、非生产用途）。\n//!\n//! 纯标准库实现：`TcpListener` + 每连接一个线程，请求全程持有\n//! [`crate::store::SharedStore`] 上的互斥锁（写者唯一）。\n//!\n//! # 路由\n//!\n//! | 方法   | 路径                | 说明                              |\n//! |--------|---------------------|-----------------------------------|\n//! | GET    | `/health`           | 存活检查                          |\n//! | POST   | `/append`           | 追加一条记录，见下方请求体        |\n//! | GET    | `/records`          | 读取全部记录（按 seq 升序）       |\n//! | POST   | `/rotate`           | 显式轮转                          |\n//! | GET    | `/status`           | 存储状态                          |\n//!\n//! `/append` 请求体（JSON，手写极简解析）：\n//! `{\"data\":\"<base64 负载>\",\"text\":\"<UTF-8 字符串负载>\"}`\n//! 二选一，同时给出时以 `data` 为准。base64 可精确表达任意字节。\n//!\n//! 响应统一为 JSON；记录负载同时给出 base64（`data_b64`）与\n//! UTF-8 可打印时的 `text`。\n\nuse crate::store::{SharedStore, StoreError};\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\n/// 运行 HTTP 服务直到出错或进程结束。\npub fn run(addr: &str, store: SharedStore) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n    eprintln!(\"seg-log server listening on http://{addr}\");\n    for conn in listener.incoming() {\n        match conn {\n            Ok(stream) => {\n                let store = Arc::clone(&store);\n                std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                    let _ = handle(stream, store);\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept failed: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn handle(mut stream: TcpStream, store: SharedStore) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5)))?;\n    let mut raw = Vec::with_capacity(4096);\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];\n    // 读到 header 结束，再按 Content-Length 读满 body。\n    let header_end = loop {\n        if let Some(i) = find_header_end(&raw) {\n            break i;\n        }\n        if raw.len() > 1024 * 1024 {\n            return respond(&mut stream, 413, r#\"{\"error\":\"headers too large\"}\"#);\n        }\n        let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        raw.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]);\n    };\n\n    let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = head.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = match lines.next() {\n        Some(l) => l,\n        None => return respond(&mut stream, 400, r#\"{\"error\":\"bad request\"}\"#),\n    };\n    let mut parts = request_line.split_whitespace();\n    let (method, path) = match (parts.next(), parts.next()) {\n        (Some(m), Some(p)) => (m.to_string(), p.to_string()),\n        _ => return respond(&mut stream, 400, r#\"{\"error\":\"bad request line\"}\"#),\n    };\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some(rest) = line.to_ascii_lowercase().strip_prefix(\"content-length:\") {\n            content_length = rest.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0);\n        }\n    }\n    if content_length > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n        return respond(&mut stream, 413, r#\"{\"error\":\"body too large\"}\"#);\n    }\n\n    let mut body = raw[header_end + 4..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    let route = path.split('?').next().unwrap_or(\"/\");\n    let resp = route_request(&method, route, &body, &store);\n    respond(&mut stream, resp.code, &resp.body)\n}\n\nstruct Response {\n    code: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn route_request(method: &str, route: &str, body: &[u8], store: &SharedStore) -> Response {\n    match (method, route) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/health\") => ok_json(r#\"{\"status\":\"ok\",\"service\":\"seg-log\"}\"#),\n        (\"GET\", \"/status\") => {\n            let st = store.lock().unwrap().status();\n            ok_json(&format!(\n                \"{{\\\"next_seq\\\":{},\\\"active_segment\\\":{},\\\"active_bytes\\\":{},\\\"poisoned\\\":{},\\\"max_segment_bytes\\\":{}}}\",\n                st.next_seq, st.active_segment, st.active_bytes, st.poisoned, st.max_segment_bytes\n            ))\n        }\n        (\"POST\", \"/append\") => {\n            let payload = match extract_payload(body) {\n                Ok(p) => p,\n                Err(msg) => return client_error(&msg),\n            };\n            let mut s = store.lock().unwrap();\n            match s.append(&payload) {\n                Ok(a) => ok_json(&format!(\n                    \"{{\\\"ok\\\":true,\\\"seq\\\":{},\\\"segment\\\":{},\\\"offset\\\":{}}}\",\n                    a.seq, a.segment, a.offset\n                )),\n                Err(e) => store_error(e),\n            }\n        }\n        (\"POST\", \"/rotate\") => {\n            let mut s = store.lock().unwrap();\n            match s.rotate() {\n                Ok(r) => ok_json(&format!(\n                    \"{{\\\"ok\\\":true,\\\"new_segment\\\":{}}}\",\n                    r.new_segment\n                )),\n                Err(e) => store_error(e),\n            }\n        }\n        (\"GET\", \"/records\") => {\n            let s = store.lock().unwrap();\n            match s.read_all() {\n                Ok(records) => {\n                    let mut json = String::from(r#\"{\"count\":\"#);\n                    json.push_str(&records.len().to_string());\n                    json.push_str(r#\",\"records\":[\"#);\n                    for (i, r) in records.iter().enumerate() {\n                        if i > 0 {\n                            json.push(',');\n                        }\n                        json.push_str(&format!(\n                            \"{{\\\"seq\\\":{},\\\"segment\\\":{},\\\"offset\\\":{},\\\"data_b64\\\":\\\"{}\\\",\\\"text\\\":{}}}\",\n                            r.seq,\n                            r.segment,\n                            r.offset,\n                            base64_encode(&r.payload),\n                            json_string_opt(std::str::from_utf8(&r.payload).ok())\n                        ));\n                    }\n                    json.push_str(\"]}\");\n                    ok_json(&json)\n                }\n                Err(e) => store_error(e),\n            }\n        }\n        _ => Response { code: 404, body: r#\"{\"error\":\"not found\"}\"#.to_string() },\n    }\n}\n\nfn ok_json(body: &str) -> Response {\n    Response { code: 200, body: body.to_string() }\n}\nfn client_error(msg: &str) -> Response {\n    Response { code: 400, body: format!(\"{{\\\"error\\\":{}}}\", json_string(msg)) }\n}\nfn store_error(e: StoreError) -> Response {\n    let (code, kind) = match &e {\n        StoreError::Poisoned => (503, \"poisoned\"),\n        StoreError::PayloadTooLarge { .. } => (413, \"payload_too_large\"),\n        StoreError::Io(_) => (500, \"io_error\"),\n    };\n    Response {\n        code,\n        body: format!(\"{{\\\"error\\\":\\\"{kind}\\\",\\\"message\\\":{}}}\", json_string(&e.to_string())),\n    }\n}\n\nfn respond(stream: &mut TcpStream, code: u16, json: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let reason = match code {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        413 => \"Payload Too }\n\n    let mut body = raw[header_end + 4..].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n {"parentUuid":"2b0b3546-498c-475a-b391-9355a9b02ca3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_d2qxqdh23o5qepghsqqzj8sm","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b/src/main.rs","content":"//! seg-log-server 启动入口。\n//!\n//! 参数：\n//! - `--dir <PATH>`      数据目录（默认 `./data`）\n//! - `--addr <HOST:PORT>` 监听地址（默认 `127.0.0.1:8080`）\n//! - `--max-segment-bytes <N>` 自动轮转阈值，0 表示不自动轮转（默认 1MiB）\n\nuse seglog::io::RealVfs;\nuse seglog::store::{Store, StoreConfig};\nuse seglog::server;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nfn main() {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let mut dir = PathBuf::from(\"data\");\n    let mut addr = \"127.0.0.1:8080\".to_string();\n    let mut max_segment_bytes: u64 = 1024 * 1024;\n\n    let mut i = 1;\n    while i < args.len() {\n        match args[i].as_str() {\n            \"--dir\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                if let Some(v) = args.get(i) {\n                    dir = PathBuf::from(v);\n                }\n            }\n            \"--addr\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                if let Some(v) = args.get(i) {\n                    addr = v.clone();\n                }\n            }\n            \"--max-segment-bytes\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                if let Some(v) = args.get(i) {\n                    max_segment_bytes = v.parse().expect(\"invalid --max-segment-bytes\");\n                }\n            }\n            other => {\n                eprintln!(\"unknown argument: {other}\");\n                std::process::exit(2);\n            }\n        }\n        i += 1;\n    }\n\n    let vfs = Arc::new(RealVfs::new());\n    let config = StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes };\n    let (store, report) = match Store::open(&dir, vfs, config) {\n        Ok(x) => x,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"failed to open store at {}: {e}\", dir.display());\n            std::process::exit(1);\n        }\n    };\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"opened store at {}: recovered {} records in {} segment(s)\",\n        dir.display(),\n        report.recovered_records,\n        report.segments.len()\n    );\n    if let Some(t) = &report.truncated_tail {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"recovery discarded incomplete tail of segment {} at offset {} ({} bytes dropped)\",\n            t.segment, t.offset, t.dropped_bytes\n        );\n    }\n    if report.index_repaired {\n        eprintln!(\"index was missing or stale and has been rebuilt\");\n    }\n    if report.removed_temps > 0 {\n seglog::io::RealVfs;\nuse seglog::store::{Store, StoreConfig};\nuse seglog::server;\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nfn main() {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let mut dir = PathBuf::from(\"data\");\n    let mut addr = \"127.0.0.1:8080\".to_string();\n    let mut max_segment_bytes: u64 = 1024 * 1024;\n\n    let mut i = 1;\n          }\n            }\n            \"--max-segment-bytes\" => {\n                i += 1;\n                if let Some(v) = args.get(i) {\n                    max_segment_bytes = std::process::exit(2);\n            }\n        }\n        i += 1;\n    }\n\n    let vfs = Arc::new(RealVfs::new());\n    let config = StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes };\n    let (store, report) =  }\n    };\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"opened store at {}: recovered {} records in {} segment(s)\",\n        dir.display(),\n        report.recovered_records,\n        report.segments.len()\n    );\n {"parentUuid":"71f91853-7ad0-4aff-bdf1-6d484317f45f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_7p4zc7cryvbvlvhbb6xzmbkj","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b/tests/recovery.rs","content":"//! 验收测试：分段追加日志的恢复语义。\n//!\n//! 覆盖：\n//! - 正常追加 + 重新打开后的序号连续性；\n//! - 逐字节截断尾记录：每个截断点都必须恢复成功且只丢未确认尾记录；\n//! - 中间记录翻位：任何中间字节翻位都必须报错，不得静默丢弃；\n//! - 恢复后再次追加不覆盖已确认数据（偏移/内容复核）；\n//! - 轮转后跨段序号连续；\n//! - 索引删除/篡改可重建。\n\nuse seglog::frame::{encode_vec, HEADER_LEN};\nuse seglog::io::temp_dir;\nuse seglog::store::{RecoverError, Store, StoreConfig};\nuse seglog::io::RealVfs;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nfn vfs() -> Arc<dyn seglog::io::Vfs> {\n    Arc::new(RealVfs::new())\n}\n\nfn open(dir: &std::path::Path) -> (Store, seglog::store::OpenReport) {\n    Store::open(dir, vfs(), StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 0 }).unwrap()\n}\n\nfn append_n(store: &mut Store, n: u64) {\n    for seq in 0..n {\n        let payload = format!(\"record-{seq}\").into_bytes();\n        let a = store.append(&payload).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(a.seq, seq);\n    }\n}\n\nfn assert_seq_continuous(records: &[seglog::store::Record], n: u64) {\n    assert_eq!(records.len() as u64, n, \"record count mismatch\");\n    for (i, r) in records.iter().enumerate() {\n        assert_eq!(r.seq, i as u64, \"seq not continuous at index {i}\");\n        assert_eq!(r.payload, format!(\"record-{}\", i).as_bytes());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn basic_append_and_reopen_is_continuous() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"basic\");\n    {\n        let (mut s, rep) = open(&dir);\n        assert_eq!(rep.recovered_records, 0);\n        append_n(&mut s, 5);\n    } // drop = “重启”\n\n    let (s2, rep) = open(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(rep.recovered_records, 5);\n    assert!(rep.truncated_tail.is_none());\n    assert_seq_continuous(&s2.read_all().unwrap(), 5);\n    assert_eq!(s2.next_seq(), 5);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_then_append_does_not_overwrite() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"no-overwrite\");\n    {\n        let (mut s, _) = open(&dir);\n        append_n(&mut s, 3);\n    }\n    let (mut s2, _) = open(&dir);\n    let before = s2.read_all().unwrap();\n    let a = s2.append(b\"record-3\").unwrap();\n    // 新记录接在旧数据之后：偏移 == 已确认数据总长度，seq 接续。\n    assert_eq!(a.seq, 3);\n    assert_eq!(a.offset as usize, before.iter().map(|r| HEADER_LEN + 故障注入测试：通过可注入 I/O 层模拟写盘故障，验证同步边界与恢复。\n\nuse seglog::io::{Fault, FaultyVfs, RenameKind, RealVfs, temp_dir};\nuse seglog::store::{RecoverError, Store, StoreConfig, StoreError};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nfn faulty(dir: &std::path::Path, faults: Vec<Fault>) -> Store {\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn seglog::io::Vfs> = Arc::new(FaultyVfs::new(faults));\n    Store::open(dir, vfs, StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 0 })\n        .map(|(s, _)| s)\n        .unwrap()\n}\n\nfn real_open(dir: &std::path::Path) -> (Store, seglog::store::OpenReport) {\n    Store::open(dir, Arc::new(RealVfs::new()), StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 0 }).unwrap()\n}\n\n/// 撕裂追加：第 2 次 append 在帧写到一半时“崩溃”。\n/// 之后 store 必须置毒拒绝写入；重新 open 只丢弃这一帧半写尾，\n/// 第 1 条已确认记录保留，序号从 1 接续。\n#[test]\nfn torn_append_recovers_by_dropping_only_tail() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"fault-torn\");\n    let mut s = faulty(\n        &dir,\n        vec![Fault::TornAppend { nth: 2, keep_bytes: 5 }],\n    );\n    let a1 = s.append(b\"confirmed-one\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(a1.seq, 0);\n\n    let err = s.append(b\"torn-record\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Io(_)), \"got {err:?}\");\n    assert!(s.is_poisoned());\n\n    // 置毒后必须拒绝继续写，防止盖过半帧。\n    assert!(matches!(s.append(b\"more\").unwrap_err(), StoreError::Poisoned));\n\n    drop(s);\n\n    // “重启”：用真实 VFS 打开同一目录。\n    let (s2, rep) = real_open(&dir);\n    assert!(rep.truncated_tail.is_some());\n    let recs = s2.read_all().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(recs.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(recs[0].seq, 0);\n    assert_eq!(recs[0].payload, b\"confirmed-one\");\n    assert_eq!(s2.next_seq(), 1);\n\n    // 接续追加，不覆盖已确认数据。\n    let mut s2 = s2;\n    let a = s2.append(b\"after-recovery\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(a.seq, 1);\n    assert_eq!(a.segment, 0);\n    drop(s2);\n    let (s3, _) = real_open(&dir);\n    let recs = s3.read_all().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(recs.len(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(recs[0].payload, b\"confirmed-one\");\n    assert_eq!(recs[1].payload, b\"after-recovery\");\n}\n\n/// 撕裂点逐字节变化：keep_bytes 从 1 到 frame_len-1，恢复结果都应一致：\n/// 丢弃半帧，保留之前确认的记录。\n#[test]\nfn torn_append_every_split_point() {\n    let payload = b\"split-point-record\";\n    let frame_len = 20 + payload.len();\n    for keep in 1..frame_len {\n        let dir = temp_dir(\"fault-split\");\n        let mut s = faulty(&dir, vec![Fault::TornAppend { nth: 1, keep_bytes: keep }]);\n        let _ = s.append(b\"\"); // 第 1 次即触发：无已确认记录\n        assert!(s.is_poisoned());\n        drop(s);\n        let (s2, rep) = real_open(&dir);\n        assert!(rep.truncated_tail.is_some(), \"keep={keep}\");\n        assert_eq!(s2.read_all().unwrap().len(), 0);\n        assert_eq!(s2.next_seq(), 0);\n    }\n}\n\n/// 写阶段就失败：文件不变，仍置毒（保守语义），重开后无数据丢失。\n#[test]\nfn failed_write_before_bytes() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"fault-writefail\");\n    let mut s = faulty(&dir, vec![Fault::FailAppendWrite { nth: 1 }]);\n    let err = s.append(b\"x\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Io(_)));\n    assert!(s.is_poisoned());\n    drop(s);\n    let (s2, rep) = real_open(&dir);\n    assert!(rep.truncated_tail.is_none());\n    assert_eq!(s2.next_seq(), 0);\n}\n\n/// fsync 失败（字节已写）：保守置毒；重开时整帧 CRC 完好则数据保留，\n/// 只有半帧才截断——证明“确认”以成功返回为准，失败返回绝不假装成功。\n#[test]\nfn failed_sync_after_full_frame() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"fault-syncfail\");\n    let mut s = faulty(&dir, vec![Fault::FailAppendSync { nth: 1 }]);\n    let err = s.append(b\"maybe-on-disk\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Io(_)));\n    drop(s);\n    // 整帧已写入：CRC 校验通过，数据在；但它从未向调用方“确认”，\n    // 恢复器的策略是保留任何完整帧（序号连续），这与“只丢半帧尾”一致。\n    let (s2, _) = real_open(&dir);\n    let recs = s2.read_all().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(recs.len(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(recs[0].payload, b\"maybe-on-disk\");\n}\n\n/// 段提交 rename 失败：不轮转、不丢数据，清理临时文件后仍可继续写。\n#[test]\nfn segment_rename_failure_is_recoverable() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"fault-rename-seg\");\n    let mut s = Store::open(\n        &dir,\n        Arc::new(FaultyVfs::new(vec![Fault::FailRename {\n            nth: 1,\n            kind: RenameKind::Segment,\n        }])),\n        StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 0 },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    s.append(b\"before\").unwrap();\n    let err = s.rotate().unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, StoreError::Io(_)));\n    assert!(!s.is_poisoned());\n    // 仍在原段追加，偏移接续。\n    let a = s.append(b\"after\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(a.seq, 1);\n    assert_eq!(a.segment, 0);\n    drop(s);\n\n    let (s2, rep) = real_open(&dir);\n    assert!(rep.removed_temps >= 1, \"temp should be cleaned on reopen\");\n    let recs = s2.read_all().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(recs.len(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(recs[0].payload, b\"before\");\n    assert_eq!(recs[1].payload, b\"after\");\n    // 目录中不应残留 tmp 文件。\n    let mut leftovers: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&dir)\n        .unwrap()\n        .map(|e| e.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())\n        .filter(|n| n.ends_with(\".tmp\"))\n        .collect();\n    leftovers.sort();\n    assert!(leftovers.is_empty(), \"leftover temps: {leftovers:?}\");\n}\n\n/// 索引 rename 失败：段文件已提交，数据不丢；重开时索引重建。\n#[test]\nfn index_rename_failure_data_survives() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"fault-rename-idx\");\n    // 第 1 次 rename 是段提交（放行），第 2 次是索引提交（失败）。\n    let mut s = Store::open(\n        &dir,\n        Arc::new(FaultyVfs::new(vec![Fault::FailRename {\n            nth: 2,\n            kind: RenameKind::Index,\n        }])),\n        StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 0 },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    s.append(b\"r0\").unwrap();\n    let r = s.rotate().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(r.new_segment, 1); // 段提交成功\n    s.append(b\"r1\").unwrap();\n    drop(s);\n\n    let (s2, rep) = real_open(&dir);\n    assert!(rep.index_repaired);\n    let recs = s2.read_all().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(recs.len(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(recs[0].seq, 0);\n    assert_eq!(recs[1].seq, 1);\n    assert_eq!(recs[0].segment, 0);\n    assert_eq!(recs[1].segment, 1);\n}\n\n/// 中间段损坏时故障注入也不改变恢复契约：必须硬错误。\n#[test]\nfn corruption_still_fatal_with_fault_layer() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"fault-corrupt\");\n    {\n        let mut s = faulty(&dir, vec![]);\n        s.append(b\"aaaa\").unwrap();\n        s.append(b\"bbbb\").unwrap();\n    }\n    let p = dir.join(\"seg-0000000000.log\");\n    let mut data = std::fs::read(&p).unwrap();\n    // 翻第一条记录负载区的第一个字节（属于“中间记录”：后面还有完整帧）。\n    data[20] ^= 0xFF;\n    std::fs::write(&p, data).unwrap();\n\n    let vfs: Arc<dyn seglog::io::Vfs> = Arc::new(FaultyVfs::new(vec![]));\n    let err = Store::open(&dir, vfs, StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 0 }).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(\n        err,\n        RecoverError::Corrupt { .. } | RecoverError::Sequence { .. }\n    ));\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d28d8b65998c1e18d074b9bd","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3799,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":51000,"output_tokens":2625,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"876788bc-290b-4a47-a4c6-987c31d44d64","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:11:25.737Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

{"parentUuid":"5e988782-ce24-41e8-bc25-455f96f911af","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_4gldy6rtk0l2qzgydzg3pvn3","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b/tests/http_api.rs","content":"//! HTTP 验证入口的端到端测试：真实 TCP 连接 + 真实线程，无外部进程依赖。\n\nuse seglog::io::{temp_dir, RealVfs};\nuse seglog::server;\nuse seglog::store::{Store, StoreConfig};\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\n/// 在随机空闲端口启动服务，返回端口号（服务在后台线程运行）。\nfn spawn() -> u16 {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"http\");\n    let (store, _) =\n        Store::open(&dir, Arc::new(RealVfs::new()), StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 0 }).unwrap();\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let port = listener.local_addr().unwrap().port();\n    let shared = Arc::new(Mutex::new(store));\n    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n        for conn in listener.incoming() {\n            let shared = Arc::clone(&shared);\n            match conn {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = server::handle_conn(stream, shared);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(_) => break,\n            }\n        }\n    });\n    port\n}\n\n/// 用原始 socket 发一个 HTTP/1.1 请求，返回 (status, body)。\nfn request(port: u16, raw: &str) -> (u16, String) {\n    let mut s = TcpStream::connect((\"127.0.0.1\", port)).unwrap();\n    s.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    s.write_all(raw.as_bytes()).unwrap();\n    s.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut all = Vec::new();\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];\n    loop {\n        match s.read(&mut buf) {\n            Ok(0) => break,\n            Ok(n) => all.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => break,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::TimedOut => break,\n            Err(e) => panic!(\"read error: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&all);\n    let status = text\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    let body = text.split(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").nth(1).unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n    (status, body)\n}\n\nfn post(port: u16, path: &str, body: &str) -> (u16, String) {\n    request(\n        port,\n        &format!(\n            \"POST {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{body}\",\n            body.len()\n        ),\n    )\n}\n\nfn get(port: u16, path: &str) -> (u16, String) {\n    request(\n        port,\n        &format!(\"GET {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: x\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\"),\n    )\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn health_ok() {\n    let port = spawn();\n    let (code, body) = get(port, \"/health\");\n    assert_eq!(code, 200);\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"ok\\\"\") || body.contains(\"seg-log\"));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn append_then_read_sequence_and_no_overwrite() {\n    let port = spawn();\n\n    // 初始状态。\n    let (code, body) = get(port, \"/status\");\n    assert_eq!(code, 200);\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"next_seq\\\":0\"));\n\n    // 追加三条（含中文，验证 UTF-8 往返）。\n    for (i, payload) in [\"alpha\", \"beta\", \"中文记录\"].iter().enumerate() {\n        let (code, body) = post(\n            port,\n            \"/append\",\n            &format!(\"{{\\\"text\\\":\\\"{payload}\\\"}}\"),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(code, 200, \"append {i} failed: {body}\");\n        assert!(body.contains(&format!(\"\\\"seq\\\":{i}\")));\n    }\n\n    let (code, body) = get(port, \"/records\");\n    assert_eq!(code, 200);\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"count\\\":3\"), \"body: {body}\");\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"text\\\":\\\"alpha\\\"\"));\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"text\\\":\\\"beta\\\"\"));\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"text\\\":\\\"中文记录\\\"\"));\n    // 顺序：alpha 在 beta 前。\n    assert!(body.find(\"alpha\").unwrap() < body.find(\"beta\").unwrap());\n\n    // 再追加一条，验证序号接续、不覆盖。\n    let (code, body) = post(port, \"/append\", r#\"{\"data\":\"ZGVsdGE=\"}\"#);\n    assert_eq!(code, 200);\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"seq\\\":3\"), \"body: {body}\");\n\n    let (_, body) = get(port, \"/records\");\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"count\\\":4\"));\n    assert!(body.contains(\"alpha\") && body.contains(\"ZGVsdGE=\"));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn append_base64_binary_roundtrip() {\n    let port = spawn();\n    // 0x00 0x01 0xFE 0xFF 的 base64: AAH+/w==\n    let (code, _) = post(port, \"/append\", r#\"{\"data\":\"AAH+/w==\"}\"#);\n    assert_eq!(code, 200);\n    let (_, body) = get(port, \"/records\");\n    assert!(body.contains(\"AAH+/w==\"));\n    // 含不可打印字节时 text 必须为 null。\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"text\\\":null\"));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn append_missing_payload_is_400() {\n    let port = spawn();\n    let (code, _) = post(port, \"/append\", r#\"{\"wrong\":1}\"#);\n    assert_eq!(code, 400);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn rotate_endpoint_creates_new_segment() {\n    let port = spawn();\n    post(port, \"/append\", r#\"{\"text\":\"one\"}\"#);\n    let (code, body) = post(port, \"/rotate\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(code, 200, \"rotate: {body}\");\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"new_segment\\\":1\"), \"body: {body}\");\n\n    post(port, \"/append\", r#\"{\"text\":\"two\"}\"#);\n    let (_, body) = get(port, \"/records\");\n    assert!(body.contains(\"\\\"count\\\":2\"));\n    // 两条记录分属不同段。\n    let seg_one = body.find(\"\\\"segment\\\":0\").is_some();\n    let seg_two = body.contains(\"\\\"segment\\\":1\");\n    assert!(seg_one && seg_two, \"body: {body}\");\n\n    let (_, status) = get(port, \"/status\");\n    assert!(status.contains(\"\\\"active_segment\\\":1\"));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn unknown_route_404() {\n    let port = spawn();\n    assert_eq!(get(port, \"/nope\").0, 404);\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_112861feb2e60fe521200bde","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2615,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":62264,"output_tokens":2714,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"b04a1921-2636-4d42-876e-e17f0f6ef09b","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:17:33.792Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

{"parentUuid":"761a75cc-9749-44d1-9a33-63467f2e6e87","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_jnli7spopme6whzggogeha3x","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b/README.md","content":"# seg-log — 分段追加日志（纯后端，Rust，零第三方依赖）\n\n文件支持的**分段追加日志**：每条记录用「长度 + 序号 + CRC」封装成帧顺序追加；\n进程重启时执行恢复——**仅允许丢弃最后一个段尾部不完整的半帧**，\n任何**中间损坏一律报错**，拒绝静默丢数据；段轮转与索引更新均为可恢复的原子操作。\n附带一个仅用标准库实现的本地 HTTP 验证入口，以及可注入的 I/O 层用于模拟磁盘故障。\n\n> 无前端。无第三方 crate。仅 `std`。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 快速开始\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\n\n# 启动（默认数据目录 ./data，监听 127.0.0.1:8080）\n./target/release/seg-log-server --dir ./data --addr 127.0.0.1:8080\n\n# 另一终端\ncurl -s -X POST localhost:8080/append -d '{\"text\":\"hello\"}'\ncurl -s localhost:8080/records | python3 -m json.tool\n```\n\n启动参数：\n\n| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `--dir` | `./data` | 数据目录（不存在则创建） |\n| `--addr` | `127.0.0.1:8080` | 监听地址 |\n| `--max-segment-bytes` | `1048576`（1 MiB） | 活动段大小阈值，超过后下一次追加自动轮转；`0` 关闭自动轮转 |\n\n## 2. HTTP 接口\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `GET`  | `/health` | 存活检查 |\n| `GET`  | `/status` | `next_seq`、活动段、活动段字节数、是否置毒等 |\n| `POST` | `/append` | 追加一条记录 |\n| `GET`  | `/records` | 按 seq 升序读出全部记录 |\n| `POST` | `/rotate` | 显式轮转（活动段为空时为 no-op） |\n\n`/append` 请求体（JSON）：\n\n```json\n{ \"text\": \"任意 UTF-8 字符串\" }\n```\n\n或用 base64 表达任意字节负载（含 `text` 时以 `data` 为准）：\n\n```json\n{ \"data\": \"AAH+/w==\" }\n```\n\n也允许直接把裸字节作为 body 发送（不要求 JSON）。\n\n响应示例：\n\n```jsonc\n// POST /append\n{\"ok\":true,\"seq\":0,\"segment\":0,\"offset\":0}\n\n// GET /records\n{\"count\":2,\"records\":[\n  {\"seq\":0,\"segment\":0,\"offset\":0, \"data_b64\":\"aGVsbG8=\",\"text\":\"hello\"},\n  {\"seq\":1,\"segment\":0,\"offset\":28,\"data_b64\":\"AAH+/w==\",\"text\":null}\n]}\n```\n\n负载在响应中同时给出 `data_b64`（始终可用）与 `text`\n（仅当负载为可打印 UTF-8 时给出，否则为 `null`）。\n\n完整请求样例见 [`requests.http`](requests.http) 与可执行的\n[`scripts/requests.sh`](scripts/requests.sh)。\n\n## 3. 磁盘格式\n\n数据目录：\n\n```text\ndata/\n├── index.txt                 # 派生索引（可随时由段文件完整重建）\n├── index.txt.tmp             # 索引原子更新临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n├── seg-0000000000.log        # 段文件；id 为 10 位十进制，按名排序即时间序\n├── seg-0000000001.log\n└── seg-XXXXXXXXXX.log.tmp    # 轮转新段的临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n```\n\n### 3.1 记录帧（小端序）\n\n每个段由一串帧拼接而成。一帧 = 20 字节帧头 + N 字节负载：\n\n```text\n偏移  长度  字段          说明\n0     4     magic        固定 ASCII \"SLG1\"，帧哨兵（不参与 CRC）\n4     8     seq          u64 记录序号；从 0 开始，跨段全局逐 1 递增\n12    4     payload_len  u32 负载长度 N（上限 16 MiB，防止损坏长度域造成巨量分配）\n16    4     crc          u32 CRC-32/IEEE（zlib 多项式 0xEDB88320，初值 ^FFFFFFFF，结果取反）\n                         覆盖范围：seq_le || payload_len_le || payload\n20    N     payload      原始负载字节\n```\n\n可手工检视：\n\n```bash\nxxd data/seg-0000000000.log\n# 00000000: 534c 4731 0000 0000 0000 0000 0500 0000  SLG1............\n# 00000010: 743a 3e2f 6815 6865 6c6c 6f              t:/.h.hello\n```\n\n### 3.2 索引格式（派生状态，非事实来源）\n\n```text\nseg-log index v1\nnext_seq=3\nactive_segment=1\nsegment=0:0:1:2:53\nsegment=1:2:-:0:0\n```\n\n每行一个段：`segment=<id>:<first_seq>:<last_seq>:<records>:<bytes>`，\n空段首末序号写作 `-`。索引仅供快速状态展示；**open 时永远以段文件扫描结果为准，\n索引缺失、损坏或与段文件不一致都会被原子重写**。\n\n## 4. 同步边界（崩溃一致性的承诺）\n\n- **追加**：帧编码 → 单次 `write` 追加到活动段 → `fsync` 文件。\n  `POST /append` 返回 2xx 即表示该记录（连同此前全部记录）已确认落盘。\n- **轮转**：\n  1. 新段以 `.log.tmp` 创建并 `fsync`；\n  2. `rename` 为正式段名；\n  3. `fsync` 父目录，让目录项落盘 —— 到此轮转**不可撤销**；\n  4. tmp + rename + fsyncdir 原子替换派生索引。\n  索引刷新失败不影响数据（下次打开自动重建）。\n- 一次写失败（写错误或 fsync 失败）后，进程内状态可能不确定，存储立即\n  **置毒（poisoned）**：拒绝继续追加，必须重新 `open` 走恢复，\n  杜绝在可能的半帧之后继续写、覆盖已确认数据。\n\n## 5. 恢复规则（open 时执行）\n\n1. 删除全部未提交的 `.tmp` 残留（段临时文件、索引临时文件）。\n2. 按段 id 升序逐段扫描，段内逐帧校验 magic / 长度 / CRC，\n   并校验 seq 全局连续（从 0 逐 1 递增，跨段连续）。\n3. 唯一允许的数据丢失：**最后一个段**尾部一帧写了一半（帧头不全，\n   或帧头完整但负载越过文件尾），且该位置之后不存在任何 CRC 正确的完整帧。\n   满足时把段文件 `truncate` 到半帧起点，丢弃这部分未确认尾部。\n4. 以下情况一律返回错误，存储拒绝打开，需人工介入：\n   - 任意帧 magic/CRC/长度损坏；\n   - 中间帧头部或长度域损坏（即使它“看起来像尾撕裂”——\n     只要它之后还能找到一个完整合法帧，就判定为中间损坏）；\n   - 非最后段以半帧结尾；\n   - 序号缺失、重复、乱序。\n5. 重建/校正索引；空存储创建第 0 段。\n\n错误类型（`src/store.rs` 的 `RecoverError`）：`Corrupt` / `Sequence` /\n`IncompleteSegment` / `Io`。\n\n## 6. 可注入 I/O 层与故障模拟\n\n存储库只依赖 `seglog::io::Vfs` trait，不直接调用 `std::fs`：\n\n- `RealVfs`：真实磁盘，所有写都带 fsync；\n- `FaultyVfs`：在**真实磁盘**上工作（因此故障效果在“重启”后依然可见），\n  按“第 n 次操作触发一次”的脚本注入：\n  - `Fault::TornAppend { nth, keep_bytes }`：该次追加只写前 `keep_bytes`\n    字节、不 sync 即报错（撕裂尾）；\n  - `Fault::FailAppendWrite { nth }`：写前即失败；\n  - `Fault::FailAppendSync { nth }`：字节写出但 fsync 失败；\n  - `Fault::FailRename { nth, kind }`：段提交或索引提交的 rename 失败\n    （`RenameKind::Segment` / `RenameKind::Index`）。\n\n故障测试见 `tests/faults.rs`。\n\n## 7. 测试\n\n```bash\ncargo test\n```\n\n| 测试文件 | 覆盖 |\n|---|---|\n| `tests/recovery.rs` | 序号连续性；**逐字节截断尾记录**（每个截断点）；**对中间记录逐字节翻位**（必报错）；恢复后追加不覆盖已确认数据；跨段轮转连续；非末段半帧必报错；索引删除/篡改重建；自动轮转 |\n| `tests/faults.rs` | I/O 层注入的撕裂写（逐撕裂点）、写失败、fsync 失败、段/索引 rename 失败后的恢复契约 |\n| `tests/http_api.rs` | 真实 TCP 上的追加/读取/轮转/状态/错误码、base64 二进制往返、中文往返 |\n| 单元测试 | CRC 标准向量、帧的各类损坏检测、base64、JSON 字段提取 |\n\n## 8. 目录结构\n\n```text\nCargo.toml\nsrc/\n  lib.rs       模块入口\n  crc.rs       CRC-32/IEEE\n  frame.rs     帧编码/解码与损坏分类\n  io.rs        Vfs / RealVfs / FaultyVfs\n  store.rs     存储库：恢复、追加、轮转、索引\n  server.rs    标准库 HTTP 验证入口\n  main.rs      服务进程入口\ntests/         集成测试（恢复 / 故障注入 / HTTP）\nscripts/       请求样例脚本\nrequests.http  请求样例（REST Client 风格）\n```\n\n## 9. 范围与非目标\n\n- 单机、单写者；HTTP 层以互斥锁保证一个写者。\n- 验证用 HTTP 服务无鉴权、仅建议绑定回环地址，不做前端。\n- 不做日志压缩、保留策略（retention）、fsync 批量/组提交。\n- CRC-32 用于检出意外损坏，不提供纠错能力。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_bffb0ecf5b6a306ee40a671b","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":540,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":66360,"output_tokens":2820,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"type":"assistant","uuid":"1ef07d3f-82ca-4368-9c30-71a2efca9b2c","timestamp":"2026-09-22T16:18:55.444Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/b","sessionId":"57642f85-c13d-47e6-8fa7-94ac1da8b485","version":"2.1.197","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-b","slug":"purrfect-stargazing-sunbeam"}

HTTP 接口\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `GET`  | `/health` | 存活检查 |\n| `GET`  | `/status` | `next_seq`、活动段、活动段字节数、是否置毒等 |\n| `POST` | `/append` | 追加一条记录 |\n| `GET`  | `/records` | 按 seq 升序读出全部记录 |\n| `POST` | `/rotate` | 显式轮转（活动段为空时为 no-op） |\n\n`/append` 请求体（JSON）：\n\n```json\n{ \"text\": \"任意 UTF-8 字符串\" }\n```\n\n或用 base64 表达任意字节负载（含 `text` 时以 `data` 为准）：\n\n```json\n{ \"data\": \"AAH+/w==\" }\n```\n\n也允许直接把裸字节作为 body 发送（不要求 JSON）。\n\n响应示例：\n\n```jsonc\n// POST /append\n{\"ok\":true,\"seq\":0,\"segment\":0,\"offset\":0}\n\n// GET /records\n{\"count\":2,\"records\":[\n  {\"seq\":0,\"segment\":0,\"offset\":0, \"data_b64\":\"aGVsbG8=\",\"text\":\"hello\"},\n  {\"seq\":1,\"segment\":0,\"offset\":28,\"data_b64\":\"AAH+/w==\",\"text\":null}\n]}\n```\n\n负载在响应中同时给出 `data_b64`（始终可用）与 `text`\n（仅当负载为可打印 UTF-8 时给出，否则为 `null`）。\n\n完整请求样例见 [`requests.http`](requests.http) 与可执行的\n[`scripts/requests.sh`](scripts/requests.sh)。\n\n## 3. 磁盘格式\n\n数据目录：\n\n```text\ndata/\n├── index.txt                 # 派生索引（可随时由段文件完整重建）\n├── index.txt.tmp             # 索引原子更新临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n├── seg-0000000000.log        # 段文件；id 为 10 位十进制，按名排序即时间序\n├── seg-0000000001.log\n└── seg-XXXXXXXXXX.log.tmp    # 轮转新段的临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n```\n\n### 3.1 记录帧（小端序）\n\n每个段由一串帧拼接而成。一帧 = 20 字节帧头 + N 字节负载：\n\n```text\n偏移  长度  字段          说明\n0     4     magic        固定 ASCII \"SLG1\"，帧哨兵（不参与 CRC）\n4     8     seq          u64 记录序号；从 0 开始，跨段全局逐 1 递增\n12    4     payload_len  u32 负载长度 N（上限 16 MiB，防止损坏长度域造成巨量分配）\n16    4     crc          u32 CRC-32/IEEE（zlib 多项式 0xEDB88320，初值 ^FFFFFFFF，结果取反）\n                         覆盖范围：seq_le || payload_len_le || payload\n20    N     payload      原始负载字节\n```\n\n可手工检视：\n\n```bash\nxxd data/seg-0000000000.log\n# 00000000: 534c 4731 0000 0000 0000 0000 0500 0000  SLG1............\n# 00000010: 743a 3e2f 6815 6865 6c6c 6f              t:/.h.hello\n```\n\n### 3.2 索引格式（派生状态，非事实来源）\n\n```text\nseg-log index v1\nnext_seq=3\nactive_segment=1\nsegment=0:0:1:2:53\nsegment=1:2:-:0:0\n```\n\n每行一个段：`segment=<id>:<first_seq>:<last_seq>:<records>:<bytes>`，\n空段首末序号写作 magic/CRC/长度损坏；\n   - 中间帧头部或长度域损坏（即使它“看起来像尾撕裂”——\n     只要它之后还能找到一个完整合法帧，就判定为中间损坏）；\n   - 非最后段以半帧结尾；\n   - 序号缺失、重复、乱序。\n5. 重建/校正索引；空存储创建第 0 段。\n\n错误类型（`src/store.rs` 的 `RecoverError`）：`Corrupt` / `Sequence` /\n`IncompleteSegment` / `Io`。\n\n## 6. 可注入 I/O 层与故障模拟\n\n存储库只依赖 `seglog::io::Vfs` trait，不直接调用 `std::fs`：\n\n- `RealVfs`：真实磁盘，所有写都带 fsync；\n- `FaultyVfs`：在**真实磁盘**上工作（因此故障效果在“重启”后依然可见），\n }\n\nsay \"health\"\ncurl -sS \"$BASE/health\"; echo\n\nsay \"status (before)\"\ncurl -sS \"$BASE/status\"; echo\n\nsay \"append text\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/append\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"text\":\"hello\"}'; echo\n\nsay \"append binary (base64 00 01 fe ff)\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/append\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"data\":\"AAH+/w==\"}'; echo\n\nsay \"append unicode\"\ncurl -sS -X POST \"$BASE/append\" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{\"text\":\"分段日志\"}'; {"parentUuid":"4ba387c5-509d-4e2e-a3bf-2a044c9b39a9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"5bd959d1-4841-4578-bc62-5945999f4c4b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_gfmoip11afdctjntveegk86r","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//! 文件支持的分段追加日志存储库。\n2\t//!\n3\t//! ## 磁盘布局\n4\t//!\n5\t//! ```text\n6\t//! <dir>/\n7\t//!   index.txt                 派生索引（可随时由段文件重建）\n8\t//!   index.txt.tmp             索引原子更新临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n9\t//!   seg-0000000000.log        段文件，id 为 10 位十进制、按 id 排序即时间顺序\n10\t//!   seg-0000000001.log\n11\t//!   seg-XXXXXXXXXX.log.tmp    轮转临时文件（崩溃残留，open 时清理）\n12\t//! ```\n13\t//!\n14\t//! ## 同步边界（durability）\n15\t//!\n16\t//! - 每条记录：编码为一帧 → 单次 `write` 追加到活动段 → `fsync` 文件。\n17\t//!   `append` 成功返回即该记录已确认（durable），且此前所有记录一并 durable。\n18\t//! - 轮转：新建临时段并 fsync → `rename` 为正式段名 → fsync 父目录；\n19\t//!   随后以 tmp+rename+fsyncdir 更新索引。\n20\t//! - 索引是**派生状态**：open 时永远以段文件扫描结果为准重建/校正索引，\n21\t//!   因此“段已提交但索引未更新”的崩溃窗口可恢复，索引丢失/损坏也可恢复。\n22\t//!\n23\t//! ## 恢复规则（open）\n24\t//!\n25\t//! 1. 按 id 依次扫描每个段；帧内 seq 必须全局连续（从 0 开始逐 1 递增，跨段连续）。\n26\t//! 2. 仅允许**最后一个段**的**尾部**存在一帧写了一半的情况\n27\t//!    （帧头不全 / 帧头完整但负载越过 EOF）：将文件截断到该帧起点丢弃之。\n28\t//! 3. 以下情况一律返回错误，不丢数据：\n29\t//!    - 任意位置 magic/CRC/长度域损坏（[`RecoverError::Corrupt`]）；\n30\t//!    - 序号不连续（[`RecoverError::Sequence`]）；\n31\t//!    - 非最后段尾部不完整（[`RecoverError::IncompleteSegment`]）。\n32\t//! 4. 清理未提交的 `.tmp` 残留；索引缺失或与扫描不符则重写。\n33\t\n34\tuse crate::frame::{self, Frame, FrameError, HEADER_LEN};\n35\tuse crate::io::Vfs;\n36\tuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n37\tuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n38\t\n39\t/// 段文件名前缀与位数。\n40\tpub const SEG_PREFIX: &str = \"seg-\";\n41\tpub const SEG_SUFFIX: &str = \".log\";\n42\tpub const SEG_ID_WIDTH: usize = 10;\n43\tpub const INDEX_NAME: &str = \"index.txt\";\n44\tconst INDEX_TMP: &str = \"index.txt.tmp\";\n45\t\n46\t/// 存储配置。\n47\t#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n48\tpub struct StoreConfig {\n49\t    /// 活动段大小阈值（字节）：append 后若超过该值则下一次 append 前自动轮转。\n50\t    /// 0 表示不自动轮转。\n51\t    pub max_segment_bytes: u64,\n52\t}\n53\t\n54\timpl Default for StoreConfig {\n55\t    fn default() -> Self {\n56\t        StoreConfig { max_segment_bytes: 1024 * 1024 }\n57\t    }\n58\t}\n59\t\n60\t/// 一条已读出的记录。\n61\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\n62\tpub struct Record {\n63\t    pub seq: u64,\n64\t    pub segment: u64,\n65\t    /// 帧在段文件内的起始偏移。\n66\t    pub offset: u64,\n67\t    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n68\t}\n69\t\n70\t/// 段的元数据（扫描得到）。\n71\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\n72\tpub struct SegmentMeta {\n73\t    pub id: u64,\n74\t    pub first_seq: Option<u64>,\n75\t    pub last_seq: Option<u64>,\n76\t    pub records: u64,\n77\t    pub bytes: u64,\n78\t}\n79\t\n80\t/// open 的结果报告。\n81\t#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n82\tpub struct OpenReport {\n83\t    pub recovered_records: u64,\n84\t    pub segments: Vec<SegmentMeta>,\n85\t    /// 若末段尾部被丢弃，给出段 id、截断位置与丢弃字节数。\n86\t    pub truncated_tail: Option<TruncatedTail>,\n87\t    /// 索引曾丢失/损坏/不一致并已重建。\n88\t    pub index_repaired: bool,\n89\t    /// 清理掉的未提交临时文件数。\n90\t    pub removed_temps: usize,\n91\t}\n92\t\n93\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\n94\tpub struct TruncatedTail {\n95\t    pub segment: u64,\n96\t    pub offset: u64,\n97\t    pub dropped_bytes: u64,\n98\t}\n99\t\n100\t/// append 成功返回。\n101\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\n102\tpub struct Appended {\n103\t    pub seq: u64,\n104\t    pub segment: u64,\n105\t    pub offset: u64,\n106\t}\n107\t\n108\t/// rotate 成功返回。\n109\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\n110\tpub struct Rotated {\n111\t    pub new_segment: u64,\n112\t}\n113\t\n114\t/// 恢复错误——硬错误，存储拒绝打开，避免静默丢数据。\n115\t#[derive(Debug)]\n116\tpub enum RecoverError {\n117\t    Io(std::io::Error),\n118\t    /// 段中段损坏（CRC/magic/长度）。任何段任何位置都不可接受。\n119\t    Corrupt {\n120\t        segment: u64,\n121\t        offset: u64,\n122\t        source: FrameError,\n123\t    },\n124\t    /// 序号缺失、重复或乱序。\n125\t    Sequence {\n126\t        segment: u64,\n127\t        offset: u64,\n128\t        expected: u64,\n129\t        got: u64,\n130\t    },\n131\t    /// 非最后一个段以半帧结尾。\n132\t    IncompleteSegment { segment: u64, offset: u64 },\n133\t}\n134\t\n135\timpl std::fmt::Display for RecoverError {\n136\t    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n137\t        match self {\n138\t            RecoverError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"I/O error during recovery: {e}\"),\n139\t            RecoverError::Corrupt { segment, offset, source } => write!(\n140\t                f,\n141\t                \"corruption in segment {segment} at offset {offset}: {source}; \\\n142\t                 middle corruption is fatal, manual intervention required\"\n143\t            ),\n144\t            RecoverError::Sequence { segment, offset, expected, got } => write!(\n145\t                f,\n146\t                \"sequence break in segment {segment} at offset {offset}: \\\n147\t                 expected seq {expected}, found {got}\"\n148\t            ),\n149\t            RecoverError::IncompleteSegment { segment, offset } => write!(\n150\t                f,\n151\t                \"non-final segment {segment} ends with a partial frame at offset {offset}\"\n152\t            ),\n153\t        }\n154\t    }\n155\t}\n156\timpl std::error::Error for RecoverError {}\n157\t\n158\t/// 运行期错误。\n159\t#[derive(Debug)]\n160\tpub enum StoreError {\n161\t    Io(std::io::Error),\n162\t    /// 上一次 append 失败后状态不确定（可能尾部有半帧），必须重新 open 才能继续写。\n163\t    Poisoned,\n164\t    PayloadTooLarge { size: usize },\n165\t}\n166\t\n167\timpl std::fmt::Display for StoreError {\n168\t    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n169\t        match self {\n170\t            StoreError::Io(e) => write!(f, \"I/O error: {e}\"),\n171\t            StoreError::Poisoned => write!(\n172\t                f,\n173\t                \"store is poisoned after a failed append; reopen to recover the tail\"\n174\t            ),\n175\t            StoreError::PayloadTooLarge { size } => {\n176\t                write!(f, \"payload of {size} bytes exceeds the frame limit\")\n177\t            }\n178\t        }\n179\t    }\n180\t}\n181\timpl std::error::Error for StoreError {}\n182\t\n183\timpl From<std::io::Error> for StoreError {\n184\t    fn from(e: std::io::Error) -> Self {\n185\t        StoreError::Io(e)\n186\t    }\n187\t}\n188\timpl From<std::io::Error> for RecoverError {\n189\t    fn from(e: std::io::Error) -> Self {\n190\t        RecoverError::Io(e)\n191\t    }\n192\t}\n193\t\n194\t/// 文件支持的分段存储库。一个实例同时只允许一个写者（HTTP 层用 Mutex 保护）。\n195\tpub struct Store {\n196\t    dir: PathBuf,\n197\t    vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n198\t    config: StoreConfig,\n199\t    active_id: u64,\n200\t    active_bytes: u64,\n201\t    next_seq: u64,\n202\t    /// 内存中的段表（open 扫描所得，append/rotate 时增量维护）。\n203\t    /// 仅用于渲染派生索引；读取与恢复始终以段文件为准。\n204\t    metas: Vec<SegmentMeta>,\n205\t    /// append 失败后置毒：拒绝后续写，直到重新 open。\n206\t    poisoned: bool,\n207\t    /// 轮转后索引刷新是否失败（派生索引落后；数据安全，下次 open 重建）。\n208\t    index_dirty: bool,\n209\t}\n210\t\n211\t/// 单段扫描结果。\n212\tstruct SegmentScan {\n213\t    meta: SegmentMeta,\n214\t    decoded: Vec<Frame>,\n215\t    /// 尾部半帧错误；None 表示段以完整帧结束。\n216\t    tail: Option<FrameError>,\n217\t}\n218\t\n219\tfn seg_name(id: u64) -> String {\n220\t    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0SEG_ID_WIDTH$}{SEG_SUFFIX}\", id)\n221\t}\n222\t\n223\tfn seg_tmp_name(id: u64) -> String {\n224\t    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0SEG_ID_WIDTH$}{SEG_SUFFIX}.tmp\", id)\n225\t}\n226\t\n227\tfn parse_seg_name(name: &str) -> Option<u64> {\n228\t    let body = name\n229\t        .strip_prefix(SEG_PREFIX)?\n230\t        .strip_suffix(SEG_SUFFIX)?;\n231\t    if body.len() != SEG_ID_WIDTH || !body.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {\n232\t        return None;\n233\t    }\n234\t    body.parse().ok()\n235\t}\n236\t\n237\tfn seg_path(dir: &Path, id: u64) -> PathBuf {\n238\t    dir.join(seg_name(id))\n239\t}\n240\t\n241\t/// 扫描一个段的字节，返回帧列表与有效长度。不在此处做序号检查。\n242\tfn scan_segment(id: u64, data: &[u8]) -> Result<SegmentScan, RecoverError> {\n243\t    let mut decoded = Vec::new();\n244\t    let mut off = 0usize;\n245\t    while off < data.len() {\n246\t        match frame::decode_at(&data[off..], off as u64) {\n247\t            Ok(f) => {\n248\t                off += HEADER_LEN + f.payload.len();\n249\t                decoded.push(f);\n250\t            }\n251\t            Err(e @ FrameError::Truncated { .. }) => {\n252\t                // “从这里凑不出一帧”有两种物理上不同的成因：\n253\t                // 1) 最后一帧写了一半（真尾撕裂）：off 之后到 EOF 只有碎片；\n254\t                // 2) 中间帧头部/长度域损坏，把帧边界指到了 EOF 之外：\n255\t                //    off 之后其实还有后续帧。\n256\t                // 真撕裂时 EOF 之后不存在任何字节，因此 off 之后若还能找到\n257\t                // 任意一个 CRC 正确的完整帧，必然是中间损坏，硬报错，\n258\t                // 绝不允许把后续已确认记录当尾巴丢掉。\n259\t                if contains_valid_frame_after(data, off + 1) {\n260\t                    return Err(RecoverError::Corrupt {\n261\t                        segment: id,\n262\t                        offset: off as u64,\n263\t                        source: FrameError::Corrupt {\n264\t                            at: off as u64,\n265\t                            reason: \"frame header/length points past following valid frame\",\n266\t                        },\n267\t                    });\n268\t                }\n269\t                return Ok(SegmentScan {\n270\t                    meta: SegmentMeta {\n271\t                        id,\n272\t                        first_seq: decoded.first().map(|f| f.seq),\n273\t                        last_seq: decoded.last().map(|f| f.seq),\n274\t                        records: decoded.len() as u64,\n275\t                        bytes: off as u64,\n276\t                    },\n277\t                    decoded,\n278\t                    tail: Some(e),\n279\t                });\n280\t            }\n281\t            Err(source) => {\n282\t                return Err(RecoverError::Corrupt {\n283\t                    segment: id,\n284\t                    offset: off as u64,\n285\t                    source,\n286\t                });\n287\t            }\n288\t        }\n289\t    }\n290\t    Ok(SegmentScan {\n291\t        meta: SegmentMeta {\n292\t            id,\n293\t            first_seq: decoded.first().map(|f| f.seq),\n294\t            last_seq: decoded.last().map(|f| f.seq),\n295\t            records: decoded.len() as u64,\n296\t            bytes: off as u64,\n297\t        },\n298\t        decoded,\n299\t        tail: None,\n300\t    })\n301\t}\n302\t\n303\t/// 在 `data[from..]` 中是否存在任意一个能完整解码且 CRC 正确的帧。\n304\t/// 用于区分“真尾撕裂”与“中间帧长度/头部损坏”。\n305\tfn contains_valid_frame_after(data: &[u8], from: usize) -> bool {\n306\t    let mut p = from;\n307\t    while p + HEADER_LEN <= data.len() {\n308\t        let rel = match data[p..].windows(4).position(|w| w == frame::MAGIC) {\n309\t            Some(r) => r,\n310\t            None => return false,\n311\t        };\n312\t        let q = p + rel;\n313\t        if q + HEADER_LEN > data.len() {\n314\t            return false;\n315\t        }\n316\t        if frame::decode_at(&data[q..], q as u64).is_ok() {\n317\t            return true;\n318\t        }\n319\t        p = q + 1;\n320\t    }\n321\t    false\n322\t}\n323\t\n324\t/// 索引文本格式（见 README“磁盘格式”）。\n325\tfn render_index(next_seq: u64, active: u64, metas: &[SegmentMeta]) -> String {\n326\t    let mut s = String::new();\n327\t    s.push_str(\"seg-log index v1\\n\");\n328\t    s.push_str(&format!(\"next_seq={next_seq}\\n\"));\n329\t    s.push_str(&format!(\"active_segment={active}\\n\"));\n330\t    for m in metas {\n331\t        match (m.first_seq, m.last_seq) {\n332\t            (Some(a), Some(b)) => {\n333\t                s.push_str(&format!(\n334\t                    \"segment={}:{}:{}:{}:{}\\n\",\n335\t                    m.id, a, b, m.records, m.bytes\n336\t                ));\n337\t            }\n338\t            _ => s.push_str(&format!(\"segment={}::-:0:{}\\n\", m.id, m.bytes)),\n339\t        }\n340\t    }\n341\t    s\n342\t}\n343\t\n344\t/// 解析索引；任何不符都返回 None（调用方据此重建）。\n345\tfn parse_index(text: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64, Vec<SegmentMeta>)> {\n346\t    let mut lines = text.lines();\n347\t    if lines.next()? != \"seg-log index v1\" {\n348\t        return None;\n349\t    }\n350\t    let mut next_seq = None;\n351\t    let mut active = None;\n352\t    let mut metas = Vec::new();\n353\t    for line in lines {\n354\t        if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"next_seq=\") {\n355\t            next_seq = Some(v.parse().ok()?);\n356\t        } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"active_segment=\") {\n357\t            active = Some(v.parse().ok()?);\n358\t        } else if let Some(v) = line.strip_prefix(\"segment=\") {\n359\t            let mut it = v.split(':');\n360\t            let id = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n361\t            let first = it.next()?;\n362\t            let last = it.next()?;\n363\t            let records = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n364\t            let bytes = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;\n365\t            if it.next().is_some() {\n366\t                return None;\n367\t            }\n368\t            let (first_seq, last_seq) = if first == \"-\" && last == \"-\" {\n369\t                (None, None)\n370\t            } else {\n371\t                (Some(first.parse().ok()?), Some(last.parse().ok()?))\n372\t            };\n373\t            metas.push(SegmentMeta { id, first_seq, last_seq, records, bytes });\n374\t        } else if line.is_empty() {\n375\t            // 允许末尾空行\n376\t        } else {\n377\t            return None;\n378\t        }\n379\t    }\n380\t    Some((next_seq?, active?, metas))\n381\t}\n382\t\n383\timpl Store {\n384\t    /// 打开（必要时创建）存储库并执行恢复，详见模块文档。\n385\t    pub fn open(\n386\t        dir: impl AsRef<Path>,\n387\t        vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n388\t        config: StoreConfig,\n389\t    ) -> Result<(Store, OpenReport), RecoverError> {\n390\t        let dir = dir.as_ref().to_path_buf();\n391\t        vfs.create_dir_all(&dir)?;\n392\t\n393\t        // 1) 清理未提交的临时文件。\n394\t        let mut removed_temps = 0usize;\n395\t        for name in vfs.list(&dir).unwrap_or_default() {\n396\t            if name == INDEX_TMP\n397\t                || (name.starts_with(SEG_PREFIX) && name.ends_with(\".log.tmp\"))\n398\t            {\n399\t                let _ = vfs.remove_file(&dir.join(&name));\n400\t                removed_temps += 1;\n401\t            }\n402\t        }\n403\t\n404\t        // 2) 列出全部正式段。\n405\t        let mut ids: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();\n406\t        for name in vfs.list(&dir)? {\n407\t            if let Some(id) = parse_seg_name(&name) {\n408\t                ids.push(id);\n409\t            }\n410\t        }\n411\t        ids.sort_unstable();\n412\t        ids.dedup();\n413\t\n414\t        // 3) 逐段扫描，校验“仅末段允许尾部半帧”与全局序号连续。\n415\t        let mut metas = Vec::new();\n416\t        let mut recovered_records = 0u64;\n417\t        let mut truncated_tail = None;\n418\t        let mut expected_seq = 0u64;\n419\t\n420\t        let last_id = ids.len().checked_sub(1);\n421\t        for (idx, &id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {\n422\t            let path = seg_path(&dir, id);\n423\t            let data = vfs.read(&path)?;\n424\t            let scan = scan_segment(id, &data)?;\n425\t\n426\t            if let Some(tail) = &scan.tail {\n427\t                if Some(idx) != last_id {\n428\t                    // 非最后段尾部不完整：硬错误。\n429\t                    if let FrameError::Truncated { at, .. } = tail {\n430\t                        return Err(RecoverError::IncompleteSegment {\n431\t                            segment: id,\n432\t                            offset: *at,\n433\t                        });\n434\t                    }\n435\t                }\n436\t                // 最后一段尾部半帧：截断丢弃。\n437\t                if let FrameError::Truncated { at, present } = tail {\n438\t                    let dropped = data.len() as u64 - *at;\n439\t                    vfs.truncate_sync(&path, *at)?;\n440\t                    truncated_tail = Some(TruncatedTail {\n441\t                        segment: id,\n442\t                        offset: *at,\n443\t                        dropped_bytes: dropped,\n444\t                    });\n445\t                    let _ = present; // present = data.len()-at，含义同 dropped\n446\t                }\n447\t            }\n448\t\n449\t            for f in &scan.decoded {\n450\t                if f.seq != expected_seq {\n451\t                    return Err(RecoverError::Sequence {\n452\t                        segment: id,\n453\t                        offset: 0,\n454\t                        expected: expected_seq,\n455\t                        got: f.seq,\n456\t                    });\n457\t                }\n458\t                expected_seq += 1;\n459\t            }\n460\t            recovered_records += scan.decoded.len() as u64;\n461\t            metas.push(scan.meta);\n462\t        }\n463\t\n464\t        // 4) 空存储：创建第 0 段。\n465\t        let active_id = match ids.last() {\n466\t            Some(&id) => id,\n467\t            None => {\n468\t                let p = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n469\t                vfs.create_truncate_sync(&p, &[])?;\n470\t                vfs.sync_dir(&dir)?;\n471\t                metas.push(SegmentMeta {\n472\t                    id: 0,\n473\t                    first_seq: None,\n474\t                    last_seq: None,\n475\t                    records: 0,\n476\t                    bytes: 0,\n477\t                });\n478\t                0u64\n479\t            }\n480\t        };\n481\t        let active_bytes = metas.iter().find(|m| m.id == active_id).map(|m| m.bytes).unwrap_or(0);\n482\t\n483\t        // 5) 索引核对 / 重建（派生状态）。\n484\t        let index_path = dir.join(INDEX_NAME);\n485\t        let want_index = render_index(expected_seq, active_id, &metas);\n486\t        let mut index_repaired = false;\n487\t        let on_disk = vfs.read(&index_path).ok();\n488\t        match on_disk {\n489\t            Some(bytes) if bytes == want_index.as_bytes() => {}\n490\t            _ => {\n491\t                Self::write_index(&vfs, &dir, want_index.as_bytes())?;\n492\t                index_repaired = true;\n493\t            }\n494\t        }\n495\t\n496\t        let store = Store {\n497\t            dir,\n498\t            vfs,\n499\t            config,\n500\t            active_id,\n501\t            active_bytes,\n502\t            next_seq: expected_seq,\n503\t            metas,\n504\t            poisoned: false,\n505\t            index_dirty: false,\n506\t        };\n507\t        let report = OpenReport {\n508\t            recovered_records,\n509\t            segments: metas,\n510\t            truncated_tail,\n511\t            index_repaired,\n512\t            removed_temps,\n513\t        };\n514\t        Ok((store, report))\n515\t    }\n516\t\n517\t    /// tmp + rename + fsync(dir) 原子替换索引。\n518\t    fn write_index(vfs: &Arc<dyn Vfs>, dir: &Path, data: &[u8]) -> Result<(), RecoverError> {\n519\t        let tmp = dir.join(INDEX_TMP);\n520\t        vfs.create_truncate_sync(&tmp, data)?;\n521\t        vfs.rename(&tmp, &dir.join(INDEX_NAME))?;\n522\t        vfs.sync_dir(dir)?;\n523\t        Ok(())\n524\t    }\n525\t\n526\t    fn active_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n527\t        seg_path(&self.dir, self.active_id)\n528\t    }\n529\t\n530\t    /// 下一条记录序号。\n531\t    pub fn next_seq(&self) -> u64 {\n532\t        self.next_seq\n533\t    }\n534\t\n535\t    /// 当前活动段 id。\n536\t    pub fn active_segment(&self) -> u64 {\n537\t        self.active_id\n538\t    }\n539\t\n540\t    /// 存储是否处于“写失败后需重开”状态。\n541\t    pub fn is_poisoned(&self) -> bool {\n542\t        self.poisoned\n543\t    }\n544\t\n545\t    /// 活动段当前字节数。\n546\t    pub fn active_bytes(&self) -> u64 {\n547\t        self.active_bytes\n548\t    }\n549\t\n550\t    /// 追加一条记录；成功即 fsync 完成（见模块级“同步边界”）。\n551\t    pub fn append(&mut self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Appended, StoreError> {\n552\t        if self.poisoned {\n553\t            return Err(StoreError::Poisoned);\n554\t        }\n555\t        if payload.len() > frame::MAX_PAYLOAD as usize {\n556\t            return Err(StoreError::PayloadTooLarge { size: payload.len() });\n557\t        }\n558\t\n559\t        // 自动轮转：活动段非空且加入本帧后越过阈值。\n560\t        let frame_len = (HEADER_LEN + payload.len()) as u64;\n561\t        if self.config.max_segment_bytes > 0\n562\t            && self.active_bytes > 0\n563\t            && self.active_bytes + frame_len > self.config.max_segment_bytes\n564\t        {\n565\t frame::encode_vec(seq, payload);\n572\t\n573\t        // 关键写：任何错误都置毒——成功与否外界已无法从进程内判定，\n574\t        // 必须重新 open 走恢复，杜绝在可能的半帧之后继续追加。\n575\t        if let Err(e) = self.vfs.append_sync(&self.active_path(), &frame) {\n576\t            self.poisoned = true;\n577\t            return Err(StoreError::Io(e));\n578\t        }\n579\t\n580\t        self.next_seq += 1;\n581\t        self.active_bytes += frame_len;\n582\t        // 维护内存段表（仅用于派生索引渲染）。\n583\t        let m = self\n584\t            .metas\n585\t            .iter_mut()\n586\t            .find(|m| m.id
